4228a4a4ca125d031baf51080771324e2ab21944.english:
This enables emulation of the legacy vsyscall page.  Disabling
it is roughly equivalent to booting with vsyscall=none, except
that it will also disable the helpful warning if a program
tries to use a vsyscall.  With this option set to N, offending
programs will just segfault, citing addresses of the form
0xffffffffff600?00.

This option is required by many programs built before 2013, and
care should be used even with newer programs if set to N.

Disabling this option saves about 7K of kernel size and
possibly 4K of additional runtime pagetable memory.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以仿真遗留的 vsyscall 页面 。 残废
它大致相当于 踢与vsyscall=无,但
如果程序, 也会禁用有用的警告 。
尝试使用调音器。 将这个选项设定为 N , 违规
程序将只是错误,引用表单的地址
0xffffffff600吗?

2013年之前建立的许多程序都要求使用这个选项,
如果设置为 N , 即使在更新的程序中也应使用此护理。

禁用此选项可保存约7K个内核大小和
可能还有4K个额外的运行时间调试器内存。

4993931277eb377bfb434276018a14827a501954.english: Compile the kernel with undefined behaviour sanity checker

d9b7ec2d67c540df34d6bfc83eab2fba80d5ef6a.english:
This option enables undefined behaviour sanity checker
Compile-time instrumentation is used to detect various undefined
behaviours in runtime. Various types of checks may be enabled
via boot parameter ubsan_handle
(see: Documentation/dev-tools/ubsan.rst).

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许未定义的行为理智检查器
编译时间仪器用于检测各种未定义
行为在运行时间。 可启用各类检查
通过启动参数ubsan  handle
(见:文件/发展工具/ubsan.rst)。

dd0898f27432d3add18ff39c44339dae092fd92c.english: Enable instrumentation for the entire kernel

07cec0cdb4a5b52b7e30513c8bf4597620b35317.english:
This option activates instrumentation for the entire kernel.
If you don't enable this option, you have to explicitly specify
UBSAN_SANITIZE := y for the files/directories you want to check for UB.
Enabling this option will get kernel image size increased
significantly.

e49e4b012ae083c4dfbba06f9ba9b2407308d3cb.english:
This option enables detection of unaligned memory accesses.
Enabling this option on architectures that support unaligned
accesses may produce a lot of false positives.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可以检测不匹配的内存访问 。
对支持不匹配的架构启用此选项
访问可能会产生大量的假阳性.

ddfe39653e6e977f0e8151114393dcdfbc65c0b6.english:
This option enables detection of memory accesses via a
null pointer.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许通过 a 检测内存访问
无指针。

cedd0e37e05154cda17c6a33071ab8b0668b82fb.english: Compile the kernel with KASan: runtime memory debugger

7343c280789b5483e718ff3cdaa6d5d0c6c19ed1.english:
Enables kernel address sanitizer - runtime memory debugger,
designed to find out-of-bounds accesses and use-after-free bugs.
This is strictly a debugging feature and it requires a gcc version
of 4.9.2 or later. Detection of out of bounds accesses to stack or
global variables requires gcc 5.0 or later.
This feature consumes about 1/8 of available memory and brings about
~x3 performance slowdown.
For better error detection enable CONFIG_STACKTRACE.
Currently CONFIG_KASAN doesn't work with CONFIG_DEBUG_SLAB
(the resulting kernel does not boot).

translations.zh-CN:
启用内核地址消毒器 - 运行时内存调试器,
用于查找出界访问和无后用错误。
这纯粹是一个调试功能,需要 gcc 版本
4.9.2或以后各段。 检测到堆栈的出界访问或
全球变量需要 gcc 5.0 或 以后。
这个特性消耗了大约1/8的可用内存,并带来了
~x3 性能减速.
为了更好地发现错误,可以使用CONFIG_STACKTRACE.
目前CONFIG_KASAN不与CONFIG_DEBUG_SLAB合作.
(由此产生的内核不启动).

3d8f33c09b6778562f18652ea18c1e74135682b7.english:
This enables further checks in the kernel address sanitizer, for now
it only includes the address-use-after-scope check that can lead
to excessive kernel stack usage, frame size warnings and longer
compile time.
https://gcc.gnu.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=81715 has more

ede9ff58534b29b47ef629fa5c9dd79409c9b8e3.english:
Before every memory access compiler insert function call
__asan_load*/__asan_store*. These functions performs check
of shadow memory. This is slower than inline instrumentation,
however it doesn't bloat size of kernel's .text section so
much as inline does.

translations.zh-CN:
在每次内存访问编译器前插入函数调用
 asan load */ asan store * (英语). 这些功能执行检查
影子记忆。 这比内置仪表慢
但是它不是内核的... 文本部分的膨胀大小
就像内线一样

d43743ac743da9495efc904a70364c0cbe26cc5d.english:
Compiler directly inserts code checking shadow memory before
memory accesses. This is faster than outline (in some workloads
it gives about x2 boost over outline instrumentation), but
make kernel's .text size much bigger.
This requires a gcc version of 5.0 or later.

translations.zh-CN:
编译器直接插入密码检查阴影内存
内存访问。 速度快于大纲(一些工作量)
它能提供X2助推力 超过轮廓仪表,但。
让内核的文本大小大得多
这需要gcc版本的5.0或更晚.

2a575b3363ad7520b4c6a012a0418b937d807ed7.english: Compile the kernel with code coverage for fuzzing

6971177cdf18ff8992a41f9c8ca6770fb65f9a40.english:
KCOV exposes kernel code coverage information in a form suitable
for coverage-guided fuzzing (randomized testing).

If RANDOMIZE_BASE is enabled, PC values will not be stable across
different machines and across reboots. If you need stable PC values,
disable RANDOMIZE_BASE.

For more details, see Documentation/kcov.txt.

translations.zh-CN:
KCOV 以适合的形式曝光内核编码覆盖信息
用于覆盖制导模糊(随机测试)。

如果启用 RANDOMIZE  BASE, PC 值将无法在全局稳定
不同的机器和反弹 如果你需要稳定的PC值,
禁用 RANDOMIZE BASE。

详情见Documents/kcov.txt.

8df22ea3d42f126f5e110e2c227beed3472fe531.english: Enable comparison operands collection by KCOV

bca7cd3501a3146f85961fb022c1a8543beadcb2.english:
KCOV also exposes operands of every comparison in the instrumented
code along with operand sizes and PCs of the comparison instructions.
These operands can be used by fuzzing engines to improve the quality
of fuzzing coverage.

translations.zh-CN:
KCOV 也揭露了仪器中每个比较的操作
代码以及比较指令的操作大小和PC。
这些操作可以被模糊引擎用来提高质量
模糊的覆盖。

cdaaa72d8363e9c446288a31a4a7b1e16c32ded8.english:
If you are doing generic system call fuzzing (like e.g. syzkaller),
then you will want to instrument the whole kernel and you should
say y here. If you are doing more targeted fuzzing (like e.g.
filesystem fuzzing with AFL) then you will want to enable coverage
for more specific subsets of files, and should say n here.

translations.zh-CN:
如果你在做通用系统调用模糊(例如Syzkaller),
然后,你会想要 仪表整个内核,你应该
说你在这里。 如果你在做更多的目标模糊(例如:
文件系统与 AFL 模糊, 您想要启用覆盖
用于更具体的文件子集,并应在此表示 n。

c77ab53f9eaa4042eca1c1ba35141132dbd477cb.english: Compile the kernel with task resource/io statistics and accounting

9cc04f0c1b45476fec999163d078fab19ae62d70.english:
Enable the collection and publishing of task/io statistics and
accounting.  Enable this option to enable i/o monitoring in system
monitors.

translations.zh-CN:
允许收集和发布任务/io统计数据,
会计。 启用此选项以启用系统内的 i/o 监视
监视器。

fe5777fc1065001652bac66fa860e80daf2d3011.english: Compile the kernel with symbol table information

885676486637d480d7a287a3718da3b60bad811b.english: This will give you more information in stack traces from kernel oopses.

translations.zh-CN: 这将给您更多的信息 从内核的痕迹。

3dc92ce5cbd7a38d03923292c815d9854a2d36a3.english: Compile the kernel with tracing support

2169cf270652ec67c011387484333c3439a28686.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with tracing support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用跟踪支持编译内核.

c8ce41df30d30d7b63ebf3849ba280119562d050.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Trace system calls.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:追踪系统呼叫.

659b1ce7c70928f1dde3a799e913892efce8faa1.english: Trace process context switches and events

36770bb3b66c4b2b17ab4bb9e870dc32a320e1b5.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Trace process context switches and events.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:追踪进程上下文开关和事件.
OpenWrt配置选项:函数跟踪器.

5bfac998de25c6da16a235ac838f7125197fe3c0.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Function graph tracer.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:函数图跟踪器.

0451461869b3a9fc4596e7e80ae45fb19fd59c2a.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable/disable function tracing dynamically.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用/失效函数动态跟踪.
OpenWrt配置选项:函数配置器.

fa4044f258ccae90c1e026fffe63fcd6e895f924.english:
This option measures the time spent in irqs-off critical
sections, with microsecond accuracy.

The default measurement method is a maximum search, which is
disabled by default and can be runtime (re-)started
via:

echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_max_latency

(Note that kernel size and overhead increase with this option
enabled. This option and the preempt-off timing option can be
used together or separately.)

translations.zh-CN:
此选项衡量在irqs-off 关键值中花费的时间
区域,带有微秒精确度。

默认测量方法是最大搜索,即
默认已禁用, 可以启动运行时间( 重新)
通过:

回声 0 > /sys/内核/调试/跟踪/跟踪 max lentency

(注意内核大小和间接费用随此选项而增加)
已启用。 此选项和先发制人的时间选项可以是
合并使用或单独使用。 )

d28cf374f7ba75bc4208db398e463eb33049a2be.english:
This option measures the time spent in preemption-off critical
sections, with microsecond accuracy.

The default measurement method is a maximum search, which is
disabled by default and can be runtime (re-)started
via:

echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_max_latency

(Note that kernel size and overhead increase with this option
enabled. This option and the irqs-off timing option can be
used together or separately.)

translations.zh-CN:
此选项用于测量在先发制人的关键时间
区域,带有微秒精确度。

默认测量方法是最大搜索,即
默认已禁用, 可以启动运行时间( 重新)
通过:

回声 0 > /sys/内核/调试/跟踪/跟踪 max lentency

(注意内核大小和间接费用随此选项而增加)
已启用。 此选项和 irqs- off 计时选项可以是
合并使用或单独使用。 )

e53bd0a0cf040a8fb084e0b57f7af4cbfa0a1fd0.english: Compile the kernel with debug information

a2ef5523ae45814dbeab0fe8e008005fea86bd2c.english: This will compile your kernel and modules with debug information.

translations.zh-CN: 这将以调试信息编译您的内核和模块 。

62eb9fe7f7803b2eec3d666d3d7c65a170d728a5.english: Compile the kernel with dynamic printk

0792005cb77bfbd5875b22c6b7935229445f1043.english:
Compiles debug level messages into the kernel, which would not
otherwise be available at runtime. These messages can then be
enabled/disabled based on various levels of scope - per source file,
function, module, format string, and line number. This mechanism
implicitly compiles in all pr_debug() and dev_dbg() calls, which
enlarges the kernel text size by about 2%.

translations.zh-CN:
将级别消息编译到内核中, 而内核不会
否则可在运行时使用。 这些消息可以是
根据不同级别的范围——每个源文件,
函数、模块、格式字符串和行号。 该机制
在所有的 pr debug() 和 dev  dbg() 调用中默认编译
将内核文本大小扩大约2%。

94b2343615a12f8bce3a2558a11d39150d6a6600.english: Compile the kernel with early printk

7b4c33f7bb4fe029a9efe124168ce0ceb33df3e0.english:
Compile the kernel with early printk support.  This is only useful for
debugging purposes to send messages over the serial console in early boot.
Enable this to debug early boot problems.

translations.zh-CN:
用早期的打印支持来编译内核. 这只对
调试目的在早期启动时通过串行控制台发送消息.
启用此功能以调试早期的启动问题 。

7bf0fc61c2e0f34ead45cfb6e300ed3e8efd1535.english: Compile the kernel with kprobes support

d59edbeb83fe51088dc523ebbfd44b96c10fbccf.english:
Compiles the kernel with KPROBES support, which allows you to trap
at almost any kernel address and execute a callback function.
register_kprobe() establishes a probepoint and specifies the
callback. Kprobes is useful for kernel debugging, non-intrusive
instrumentation and testing.
If in doubt, say "N".

translations.zh-CN:
将内核编译为 KPROBES 支持, 允许您陷阱
在几乎所有内核地址中执行调用函数。
注册  kprobe () 建立探测点并指定
调用。 Kprobes 可用于内核调试, 非侵入性
仪器和测试。
如果有疑问,就说"N".

5c02e959e313e1f29ce4224143965821a21ce88f.english: Compile the kernel with asynchronous IO support

65f162468a96c7ed4a91953bb0b5b3147baff93b.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with asynchronous IO support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:以同步的IO支持编译内核.

11c9c14e50be26911c521ed6680212c170a44dde.english: Compile the kernel with io_uring support

90ba55c706cc6fdd6110455b80239e14998cfcd0.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with io_uring support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用io uring支持编译内核.

3c3642334c1c754691823a0fddbfd487b7057741.english: Compile the kernel with support for fhandle syscalls

ad412a64ce88c1dd0a1687bfb6502095666a47db.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with support for fhandle syscalls.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用支持fhandle syscalls来编译内核.

7e575ccdd3fbfd9a74a7d5450aa3fd88a3b8852e.english: Compile the kernel with modern file notification support

e7d0eed20ab6b37df2f382e0992659e74fb59154.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with modern file notification support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用现代文件通知支持编译内核.

72589387ed67f36501fd602ae20b152d618561d1.english: Compile the kernel with SCSI generic v4 support for any block device

3feb3775c25c51f4b9866b696313ba18a7b30db4.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with SCSI generic v4 support for any block device.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:将内核编译为任何块设备的SCSI通用v4支持.
OpenWrt配置选项:永远.
OpenWrt配置选项:疯狂.

f660a05452a863017f8b885ddd79ca11ffc063bd.english: Compile the kernel with HugeTLB support

37eada78b16fee45c9fc3f40c64a61b2f516a0bc.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with HugeTLB support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用巨大的TLB支持编译内核.

c59b7f06aa954c6f7dbe4b28977ea3e9f0e70acb.english: Compile the kernel with SysRq support

0147c5aee53c7ab4561b84c2ba4573183112c220.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with SysRq support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用 SysRq 支持编译内核.

8601ce6b3f7f6164d0998a3cb7c9c11866674fa8.english: Compile the kernel with pinctrl debugging

6549161db4976096575dc0ff9517fe24bd64be51.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with pinctrl debugging.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用pinctrl调试来编译内核.

59d2b6ae38273fd3ffcd665aa592fbe722fda9a7.english: Compile the kernel with gpio debugging

e59f00716883345fb90add8818c327f837336ea6.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with gpio debugging.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用gpio调试来编译内核.

afe64286a136cfddff73c73afcbc36562cfae2e9.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable process core dump support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用进程核心堆放支持.

97554b06425f8d320373f621c5f3403531045109.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable kernel lock checking.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用内核锁检查.

cf6f8708b7c30e08b2b0a67a73c75c7ee71b1485.english: Compile the kernel with detect Soft Lockups

2e8761627699d16062128df8039b0ab2b9cf920e.english:
Say Y here to enable the kernel to act as a watchdog to detect
soft lockups.

Softlockups are bugs that cause the kernel to loop in kernel
mode for more than 20 seconds, without giving other tasks a
chance to run.  The current stack trace is displayed upon
detection and the system will stay locked up.

translations.zh-CN:
说Y让内核能充当监视者来侦测
软锁.

软锁是导致内核在内核中循环的错误
模式 20 秒以上,但不给其他任务 a
机会逃跑。 当前堆栈跟踪显示于
侦测系统就会被锁起来

fa3052797899b322a72beae8f8d8563a62c2bae0.english: Compile the kernel with detect Hung Tasks

1eff205e7670c0e0c92a6ab909a0703f9f21a553.english:
Say Y here to enable the kernel to detect "hung tasks",
which are bugs that cause the task to be stuck in
uninterruptible "D" state indefinitely.

When a hung task is detected, the kernel will print the
current stack trace (which you should report), but the
task will stay in uninterruptible state. If lockdep is
enabled then all held locks will also be reported. This
feature has negligible overhead.

translations.zh-CN:
说Y让内核能探测"饥饿任务",
错误导致任务被卡在其中
无间断的"D"状态无限.

当检测到挂起的任务时,内核会打印
当前堆栈跟踪( 您应该报告), 但是
任务将处于不间断状态。 如果锁定是
启用后, 所有锁定也会被报告 。 这个
特性具有可忽略不计的间接费用。

0d91b0e7b1c89bc266b9c7e7d94839047a940610.english: Compile the kernel with detect Workqueue Stalls

32594cff75d2c98e37cb68edba6788877c431f21.english:
Say Y here to enable stall detection on workqueues.  If a
worker pool doesn't make forward progress on a pending work
item for over a given amount of time, 30s by default, a
warning message is printed along with dump of workqueue
state.  This can be configured through kernel parameter
"workqueue.watchdog_thresh" and its sysfs counterpart.

translations.zh-CN:
说Y在这里允许 摊位检测在工作井。 如果一个
工人人才库在未完成的工作方面没有取得进展
30s 默认, a
警告信息与垃圾邮件一起打印
状态。 这可以通过内核参数配置
"Workqueue.watchdog thresh"和它的sysfs对应.

03572af1b5b38f73a6eb73393dff108ba8a3b6a7.english: Compile the kernel with sleep inside atomic section checking

2fdfc81fba06b2fa570d87e791eba30f04306a9a.english:
If you say Y here, various routines which may sleep will become very
noisy if they are called inside atomic sections: when a spinlock is
held, inside an rcu read side critical section, inside preempt disabled
sections, inside an interrupt, etc...

translations.zh-CN:
如果你在这里说Y, 各种程序 可能睡眠会变得非常
如果它们被称作原子部分, 声音会响: 当一个旋锁是
在 rcu 读侧键区内, 在预置禁用
节,在中断中等等...

cb5cee284474f39d87e81de99ab02df9fd605e71.english: Compile the kernel with debug VM

bfb0f999efbcbbb975acfdce8d6578f69b218f67.english:
Enable this to turn on extended checks in the virtual-memory system
that may impact performance.

If unsure, say N.

translations.zh-CN:
启用此选项打开虚拟记忆系统中的扩展检查
这可能影响业绩。

如果不确定,请说N.

92176afd8dac843c44fc0432f758e82996fa0b9d.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable printk timestamps.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用打印卡时间戳.

b7c033aa3d21954092e38291ef3da757bd3a8bfa.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable /proc slab debug info.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用/proc slab调试信息.

764c5cb5277357b7228468cdb90ec9adc968e126.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable /proc page monitoring.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用/proc页面监控.

6b5005ca4420dd312028a7f24e0179f93c78e531.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable kexec support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用 kexec 支持.

c256c6b2cd04fd4ef1271a57137567143d17245d.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable support for kexec crashdump.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用 kexec crashdump 支持.

880ff3376416642ec3aef72660b35ceedd4f53e0.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable rfkill support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用 rfkill 支持.

4ebca403bffb44dba666b5b44c03b8a62cb9efe1.english: Enable sparse check during kernel build

8afa5d2e921deb73c9d01362f0960ac141544558.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable sparse check during kernel build.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:在内核构建过程中启用稀疏检查.

10a6d96bb67a37cb1fa98734392225fafbf00406.english: Compile the kernel with device tmpfs enabled

fdc2714bdf70fe56e6fcad3154d693c29729fcdb.english:
devtmpfs is a simple, kernel-managed /dev filesystem. The kernel creates
devices nodes for all registered devices to simplify boot, but leaves more
complex tasks to userspace (e.g. udev).

translations.zh-CN:
devtmpfs是一个简单,内核管理的/dev文件系统. 内核创建
用于所有注册设备的设备节点以简化启动,但留下更多
复杂的任务到用户空间(例如 udev).

c5ff0751cac7aca060dc57f1b30964ac30ec0cb5.english:

6f5c497b4c161303115a5a6b6e16fecbcb378993.english: Memory Resource Controller for Control Groups

fe198ba83336b12686f71be3cc625b5f7332fe7a.english:
Provides a memory resource controller that manages both anonymous
memory and page cache. (See Documentation/cgroups/memory.txt)

Note that setting this option increases fixed memory overhead
associated with each page of memory in the system. By this,
20(40)bytes/PAGE_SIZE on 32(64)bit system will be occupied by memory
usage tracking struct at boot. Total amount of this is printed out
at boot.

Only enable when you're ok with these tradeoffs and really
sure you need the memory resource controller. Even when you enable
this, you can set "cgroup_disable=memory" at your boot option to
disable memory resource controller and you can avoid overheads
(but lose benefits of memory resource controller).

This config option also selects MM_OWNER config option, which
could in turn add some fork/exit overhead.

translations.zh-CN:
提供管理同时匿名的内存资源控制器
内存和页面缓存。 (见文件/小组/备忘录.txt)

注意设置此选项会增加固定内存的间接费用
与系统内存的每页相关。 通过这个
32(64)bit系统中的20(40)字节/PAGE SIZE将被内存占用
使用跟踪脚步。 打印总数
在靴子时。

只有在你同意这些交易时 才能进行
您需要内存资源控制器 。 即使你允许
您可以在您的启动选项中设置“ cgroup  disable=memory ” 。
禁用内存资源控制器并可以避免管理费用
(但失去内存资源控制器的好处).

此配置选项还选择了 MM  OWNER 配置选项, 该选项
反过来,还可以增加一些叉/出舱费。

015b44f90470a448ab11e5115ecec3f53b17d069.english:
Add swap management feature to memory resource controller. When you
enable this, you can limit mem+swap usage per cgroup. In other words,
when you disable this, memory resource controller has no cares to
usage of swap...a process can exhaust all of the swap. This extension
is useful when you want to avoid exhaustion swap but this itself
adds more overheads and consumes memory for remembering information.
Especially if you use 32bit system or small memory system, please
be careful about enabling this. When memory resource controller
is disabled by boot option, this will be automatically disabled and
there will be no overhead from this. Even when you set this config=y,
if boot option "swapaccount=0" is set, swap will not be accounted.
Now, memory usage of swap_cgroup is 2 bytes per entry. If swap page
size is 4096bytes, 512k per 1Gbytes of swap.

translations.zh-CN:
在内存资源控制器中添加互换管理功能. 当你
启用此选项, 您可以限制每个 croup 的 mem+swap 使用 。 也就是说,
当您禁用此选项时, 内存资源控制器无需注意
使用互换... 一个过程可以耗尽所有互换。 此扩展名
当您想要避免耗尽交换时有用, 但这本身
增加了更多的间接费用,并消耗了记忆中的信息.
特别是如果您使用 32bit 系统或小内存系统,请
要小心,要让这个。 当内存资源控制器
被启动选项禁用,此选项将自动禁用,
不会再有高空飞行了 即使你设定了这个配置
如果设置“ swapcount=0” 的启动选项,则互换将不予核算。
现在,switch cgroup的内存使用是每个条目2字节. 如果换页
大小为4096字节,每1G字节互换512k.

cd1ca76b4c839103e260e465afd9dffd070550eb.english: Memory Resource Controller Swap Extension enabled by default

e95346e641f511bc3647793f8196d630160fd7c7.english:
Memory Resource Controller Swap Extension comes with its price in
a bigger memory consumption. General purpose distribution kernels
which want to enable the feature but keep it disabled by default
and let the user enable it by swapaccount boot command line
parameter should have this option unselected.

Those who want to have the feature enabled by default should
select this option (if, for some reason, they need to disable it,
then swapaccount=0 does the trick).

translations.zh-CN:
内存资源控制器交换扩展名随其价格在
一个更大的记忆消耗。 一般用途分配内核
它想要启用该特性,但默认情况下将其禁用
让用户通过互换账户启动命令行启用
参数应当未选中此选项。

希望默认启用该特性的人应当
选择此选项( 如果出于某种原因, 他们需要禁用它,
然后交换账户=0做诡计。

97df1c235bc052638fa2d02524cb1a8a9751e019.english: Memory Resource Controller Kernel Memory accounting (EXPERIMENTAL)

14dbfc43412aefad32cd0e5bf7ef3ed0a07480ed.english:
The Kernel Memory extension for Memory Resource Controller can limit
the amount of memory used by kernel objects in the system. Those are
fundamentally different from the entities handled by the standard
Memory Controller, which are page-based, and can be swapped. Users of
the kmem extension can use it to guarantee that no group of processes
will ever exhaust kernel resources alone.

translations.zh-CN:
内存资源管理器的内存扩展可以限制
系统内核对象使用的内存量。 这些是
与标准处理的实体根本不同
内存控制器,它基于页面,可以互换. 用户
千米扩展可以用来保证任何一组流程
只有内核资源才能耗尽

03051c6883e93211e6ad1c819128afa86ad55676.english: Enable perf_event per-cpu per-container group (cgroup) monitoring

a70903d6a7f73df3912f945f573acf552ada7c20.english:

cpu. (中文(简体) ).

8507de89e7fee9cbff0022ba289090b5e7c44bd2.english:

translations.zh-CN:

向此类工作组分配带宽。 它使用 cgroups 组合
任务。

b645ef1262599542c85204abed161dc9ad75daa0.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Group scheduling for SCHED_OTHER.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:SCHED other的分组调度.

06417d7327ca2892cccbf790701f832c98686121.english:
This option allows users to define CPU bandwidth rates (limits) for
tasks running within the fair group scheduler.  Groups with no limit
set are considered to be unconstrained and will run with no
restriction.
See tip/Documentation/scheduler/sched-bwc.txt for more information.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许用户定义 CPU 带宽率( 限制)
在公平小组调度器内运行的任务。 无限制的组
设定被视为不受约束,并将在无限制的情况下运行
限制。
详情请参看提示/文件/时间表/shed-bwc.txt。

6e8bc689b968d4eb6baee0e66a9089e3e98ba6f9.english:
This feature lets you explicitly allocate real CPU bandwidth
to task groups. If enabled, it will also make it impossible to
schedule realtime tasks for non-root users until you allocate
realtime bandwidth for them.

translations.zh-CN:
此功能允许您明确分配真实的 CPU 带宽
给工作组。 如果启用, 也将使无法
为非源用户安排实时任务,直到您分配
他们的实时带宽。

ced15f0bb9b021db8fd089d5b8406e1ee92fecc3.english:
Generic block IO controller cgroup interface. This is the common
cgroup interface which should be used by various IO controlling
policies.

Currently, CFQ IO scheduler uses it to recognize task groups and
control disk bandwidth allocation (proportional time slice allocation)
to such task groups. It is also used by bio throttling logic in
block layer to implement upper limit in IO rates on a device.

This option only enables generic Block IO controller infrastructure.
One needs to also enable actual IO controlling logic/policy. For
enabling proportional weight division of disk bandwidth in CFQ, set
CONFIG_CFQ_GROUP_IOSCHED=y; for enabling throttling policy, set
CONFIG_BLK_DEV_THROTTLING=y.

translations.zh-CN:
通用块 IO 控制器 croup 接口. 这是常见的
c组接口, 用于各种 IO 控制
政策。

目前,CFQ IO调度器使用它来识别任务组和
控制磁盘带宽分配(按比例的时间切片分配)
向这些工作组提出。 生物节流逻辑也使用它
块层以在设备上执行IO率的上限。

此选项只允许通用的块 IO 控制器基础设施 。
人们还需要实现实际的IO控制逻辑/政策. 对于
启用 CFQ 磁盘带宽的比例重量分配, 设定
CONFIG_CFQ_GROUP_IOSCHED=y; 用于启动节流政策, 设置
(原始内容存档于2017-09-29). CONFIG_BLK_DEV_THROTTLING=y.

5fdaf3869d074d3c4b409b8838671edf933e8566.english: Proportional weight of disk bandwidth in CFQ

2d843085f34bd58e22baaf29de1c3a4c4da3ff7c.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Proportional weight of disk bandwidth in CFQ.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:CFQ中磁盘带宽的比例重量.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:遗产网络优先cgroup.

2c073beaf67376c24cac7d5218285d75349d79cc.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable kernel namespaces.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用内核命名空间.

c8581c5766c90f8fdc3349f647e0ae2884ff0754.english:
In this namespace, tasks see different info provided
with the uname() system call.

translations.zh-CN:
在此命名空间中, 任务查看不同的信息
与 uname () 系统调用 。

7de17f217ab083cb3d4b0eeb2013f94c1d9faf6c.english:

不同名称空间的不同 IPC 对象。

95aae5b21cfb4ae104c2f90b3b0cfa2ee852339e.english:
This allows containers, i.e. vservers, to use user namespaces
to provide different user info for different servers.

translations.zh-CN:
这允许容器,即 vservers 使用用户命名空间

013edffa03f56e78efece8fa4ea3749760537e77.english:
Support process id namespaces. This allows having multiple
processes with the same pid as long as they are in different
pid namespaces. This is a building block of containers.

translations.zh-CN:
支持进程 id 命名空间 。 这允许有多个
过程,只要是不同的
(原始内容存档于2018-09-29). pid namespaces. 这是一组集装箱

c8f58576e438a1809e5fb321355650a2f92890a3.english:
Allow user space to create what appear to be multiple instances
of the network stack.

translations.zh-CN:
允许用户空间创建看起来是多个实例
网络堆栈。

d5af3d1aa0df0bbbf07659087732a0b2f2c05ab1.english:
Enable support for multiple instances of devpts filesystem.
If you want to have isolated PTY namespaces (eg: in containers),
say Y here. Otherwise, say N. If enabled, each mount of devpts
filesystem with the '-o newinstance' option will create an
independent PTY namespace.

translations.zh-CN:
启用多例 devpts 文件系统的支持 。
如果您想要隔离 PTY 命名空间( 如: 在容器中) ,
说Y在这里。 否则,说N. 如果启用, 则每个devpts的挂载
带有“-o newinsance”选项的文件系统将创建一个
独立 PTY 命名空间 。

c60ed90795d97156e420a0f5e62eacfc9c05d4b7.english:
POSIX variant of message queues is a part of IPC. In POSIX message
queues every message has a priority which decides about succession
of receiving it by a process. If you want to compile and run
programs written e.g. for Solaris with use of its POSIX message
queues (functions mq_*) say Y here.

POSIX message queues are visible as a filesystem called 'mqueue'
and can be mounted somewhere if you want to do filesystem
operations on message queues.

translations.zh-CN:
消息队列的POSIX变体是IPC的一部分. 在 POSIX 信件中
队列每个消息都有决定继承的优先权
通过一个过程得到它。 如果您想要编译和运行
使用 POSIX 消息为 Solaris 编写的程序
队列( 函数 mqQQQ) 这里说 Y 。

POSIX 消息队列作为名为“ mqueue”的文件系统可见 。
如果您想要执行文件系统, 可以挂载到某个地方
在信件队列上操作。

8a02a501b8e8376d7ae1c4ada7641a2b7522985d.english: Build kernel with support for seccomp.

a0ed6211b730b5b18a72621aff382ca1d5462e0b.english: Drop SUID state for most applets

23258876301d163b4bfba13cb657fc2caaf00844.english:
With this option you can install the busybox binary belonging
to root with the suid bit set, enabling some applets to perform
root-level operations even when run by ordinary users
(for example, mounting of user mounts in fstab needs this).

With this option enabled, busybox drops privileges for applets
that don't need root access, before entering their main() function.

If you are really paranoid and don't want even initial busybox code
to run under root for every applet, build two busybox binaries with
different applets in them (and the appropriate symlinks pointing
to each binary), and only set the suid bit on the one that needs it.

Some applets which require root rights (need suid bit on the binary
or to be run by root) and will refuse to execute otherwise:
crontab, login, passwd, su, vlock, wall.

The applets which will use root rights if they have them
(via suid bit, or because run by root), but would try to work
without root right nevertheless:
findfs, ping[6], traceroute[6], mount.

Note that if you DO NOT select this option, but DO make busybox
suid root, ALL applets will run under root, which is a huge
security hole (think "cp /some/file /etc/passwd").

translations.zh-CN:
您可以使用此选项安装繁忙的框二进制属性
,使一些小程序能够执行
根级操作, 即使由普通用户运行
(例如,在 fstab 中安装用户挂载需要这个).

启用此选项后, Busybox 将放弃小程序的权限
在进入主函数之前,不需要根访问。

如果你真的有妄想症 连最初的忙箱代码都不想要
创建两个忙箱二进制
里面有不同的小程序(和适当的连结)
对每个二进制),只设置一个需要的自定义位点.

一些需要root权限的小程序( 需要在二进制上自定义位点)

康塔布,登录,传,su,vlock,墙.

如果有根权利, 将使用根权利的小程序
(通过单位,或因为运行 根),但会尝试工作
然而,没有根权利:
findfs, ping [6], trackroute [6], 挂载.

注意, 如果您不选择此选项, 但多做繁忙框
树根,所有小程序都会在树根下运行,这是巨大的
安全洞(认为"cp / some/file /etc/passwd").

160f71c093d6083b01ddfc93ba65258fe282f671.english:
Allow the SUID/SGID state of an applet to be determined at runtime
by checking /etc/busybox.conf. (This is sort of a poor man's sudo.)
The format of this file is as follows:

APPLET = [Ssx-][Ssx-][x-] [USER.GROUP]

s: USER or GROUP is allowed to execute APPLET.
APPLET will run under USER or GROUP
(regardless of who's running it).
S: USER or GROUP is NOT allowed to execute APPLET.
APPLET will run under USER or GROUP.
This option is not very sensical.
x: USER/GROUP/others are allowed to execute APPLET.
No UID/GID change will be done when it is run.
-: USER/GROUP/others are not allowed to execute APPLET.

An example might help:

|[SUID]
|su = ssx root.0 # applet su can be run by anyone and runs with
|                # euid=0,egid=0
|su = ssx        # exactly the same
|
|mount = sx- root.disk # applet mount can be run by root and members
|                      # of group disk (but not anyone else)
|                      # and runs with euid=0 (egid is not changed)
|
|cp = --- # disable applet cp for everyone

The file has to be owned by user root, group root and has to be
writeable only by root:
(chown 0.0 /etc/busybox.conf; chmod 600 /etc/busybox.conf)
The busybox executable has to be owned by user root, group
root and has to be setuid root for this to work:
(chown 0.0 /bin/busybox; chmod 4755 /bin/busybox)

Robert 'sandman' Griebl has more information here:
<url: http://www.softforge.de/bb/suid.html >.

translations.zh-CN:
允许运行时确定一个小程序的 SUID/ SGID 状态
检查/etc/busybox.conf。 (此类贫道.
此文件的格式如下:

applet = [sx-][x-] [USER.GROUP] (英语).

s:允许使用或Group执行APPLET.
APPLET将在用户或集团下运行
(不论谁经营).
S: 不允许使用或Group执行APPLET.
APPLET将在用户或集团下运行.
这个选项不太明智。
x:允许USER/GROUP/其他人执行APPLET.
运行时不更改 UID/ GID 。
- USER/GROUP/其他人不得执行APPLET。

举例可能帮助:

[声]
|su = ssx root.0 # 小程序 su 可由任何人运行,并随运行
# euid=0, egid=0 (英语).
# # 苏= sx # 完全一样 #
|
QQmount = sx- root. disk # 小程序挂载可以由 root 和成员运行
## 组合磁盘(但不是任何人)
# # 用 euid=0 运行( 身份不变)
|
QQcp = -- -- # 禁用每个人的小程序 cp

文件必须由用户 root 、 组 root 拥有, 并且必须是
只能用根写 :
(chown 0.0/etc/busybox.conf;chmod 600/etc/busybox.conf) 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-09-02.
繁忙框可执行文件必须由用户 root, group 拥有
root 和必须设置 root 才能奏效 :
(cown 0.0/bin/busybox;chmod 4755/bin/busybox) (中文(简体) ).

罗伯特・桑德曼 Griebl 有更多信息:
(原始内容存档于2017-09-29). URL: http://www.softforge.de/bb/suid.html.

fc831a7e968dcac0c01eeac09ca3a26b60776f4f.english:

This may affect shell, find -exec, xargs and similar applets.

在没有安装/proc和ps/top的chroot监狱的问题
(命令名可以显示为小程序以这种方式启动的“ exe ” ) 。

c1798b5305b8b9a195322b7aa4a9b09a3dd0daa6.english:
When applets need to run other applets, busybox
sometimes needs to exec() itself. When the /proc filesystem is

executable. If you haven't got /proc, set this to wherever you
want to run busybox from.

the option of compiling in SELinux applets.

If you do not have a complete SELinux userland installed, this stuff
will not compile.  Specifially, libselinux 1.28 or better is
directly required by busybox. If the installation is located in a
non-standard directory, provide it by invoking make as follows:

CFLAGS=-I<libselinux-include-path>  		LDFLAGS=-L<libselinux-lib-path>  		make



Most people will leave this set to 'N'.

选项。

2cbc06c32e0a1bb5da215cce3ff79168802acdc5.english: Clean up all memory before exiting (usually not needed)

b591ba4e5462b4327bea71d9fa640fa51d77a4e2.english:
As a size optimization, busybox normally exits without explicitly
freeing dynamically allocated memory or closing files. This saves
space since the OS will clean up for us, but it can confuse debuggers
like valgrind, which report tons of memory and resource leaks.

Don't enable this unless you have a really good reason to clean
things up manually.

translations.zh-CN:
作为大小优化,繁忙框通常不明确退出
释放动态分配的内存或关闭文件。 这个可以保存
由于操作系统会为我们打扫空格,但它会混淆调试器
就像Valgrind, 它报告吨内存和资源泄漏。

除非你有很好的理由才能打扫
手动的

1a4800c214104c482079d9249ecec738c7226436.english:

Static binaries are larger, but do not require functioning

0d6bc5164df10139de3dfcf7baba2c98031daa75.english: Use the end of BSS page

ea171dfd60d999a20b17403e9c50832bc6a1ac7e.english:
Attempt to reclaim a small unused part of BSS.

Executables have the following parts:
= read-only executable code and constants, also known as "text"
= read-write data
= non-initialized (zeroed on demand) data, also known as "bss"

At link time, "text" is padded to a full page. At runtime, all "text"
pages are mapped RO and executable.

"Data" starts on the next page boundary, but is not padded
to a full page at the end. "Bss" starts wherever "data" ends.
At runtime, "data" pages are mapped RW and they are file-backed
(this includes a small portion of "bss" which may live in the last
partial page of "data").
Pages which are fully in "bss" are mapped to anonymous memory.

"Bss" end is usually not page-aligned. There is an unused space
in the last page. Linker marks its start with the "_end" symbol.

This option will attempt to use that space for bb_common_bufsiz1[]
array. If it fits after _end, it will be used, and COMMON_BUFSIZE
will be enlarged from its guaranteed minimum size of 1 kbyte.
This may require recompilation a second time, since value of _end
is known only after final link.

If you are getting a build error like this:
appletlib.c:(.text.main+0xd): undefined reference to '_end'
disable this option.

translations.zh-CN:
试图收回BSS的一小部分未使用部分.

可执行文件有下列部分:
=只读可执行代码和常数,又称"文本".
= 读写数据
=非初始化(按需为零)数据,又称"bss".

在链接时间,"文本"被添加到一个完整页. 在运行时间,所有"文本"
页面被映射 RO 和可执行文件 。

“数据”始于下一页边界,但没有添加
结尾处的完整页。 "Bss"从"数据"结束的地方开始.
在运行时间,“data”页面被映射为 RW 并被文件备份
(这包括一小部分"bs",它可能生活在最后
"数据"部分页面.
完全在"bss"中的页面被映射到匿名记忆中.

"Bss"结尾通常不与页面对齐. 有一个未使用的空间
在最后一页。 Linker用" end"符号标记它的开头.

此选项将尝试为 bb common  bufsiz1 使用该空格 []
数组。 如果在   end 之后适合,则使用 Common BUFSIZE
将会从保证的最低体积1千字节扩大。
这可能需要第二次重新汇编,因为值为 结束
只在最后链接后才能知道。

如果你遇到这样的错误:

禁用此选项 。

32-bit x86: +450 bytes of code, 75% faster

translations.zh-CN:
为sha3sum算法交易二进制大小与速度.
SHA3 SMALL=0,与SHA3 SMAL=1(近似):
64- bit x86: +270字节代码,速度更快
32位 x86:+450字节代码,速度快75%

aa2feab4f6c45c8d92cc29e548a53b51cc7db144.english:
This option makes top and ps ~20% faster (or 20% less CPU hungry),
but code size is slightly bigger.

translations.zh-CN:
这个选项使顶端和ps~20%的速度更快(或减少20%的CPU饥饿),
但代码大小稍大。

0fb91f61a262d63118f1b207c7729eed67e7a1d7.english:
Enable support for network names in /etc/networks. This is
a rarely used feature which allows you to use names
instead of IP/mask pairs in route command.

translations.zh-CN:
启用对/etc/network中的网络名称的支持. 这是
一个很少使用的允许您使用名称的特性
而不是路由命令中的 IP/ mask 配对 。

c50c084c0a0ada85167ef1e5ec072d1d15c7c5c8.english:
Look up e.g. "telnet" and "http" in /etc/services file
instead of assuming ports 23 and 80.
This is almost never necessary (everybody uses standard ports),
and it makes sense to avoid reading this file.
If you disable this option, in the cases where port is explicitly
specified as a service name (e.g. "telnet HOST PORTNAME"),
it will still be looked up in /etc/services.

translations.zh-CN:
查询例如/etc/service文件中的"telnet"和"http"
而不是假设第23和第80号港口。
这几乎从不必要(每个人都使用标准端口),
避免阅读这个文件是有道理的
如果您禁用此选项, 在指定端口的情况下
指定为服务名称(例如“telnet HOST PORNAME”),
在/etc/services中仍可查阅。

4e189b9c1c37176f6f4a2df953c25d31f7408e3f.english: Enable line editing (mainly for shell command line).

translations.zh-CN: 启用行编辑( 主要用于 shell 命令行) 。

c33bbc3ef1da554ab7ebc61a920ad13e4309e0e3.english:
Line editing code uses on-stack buffers for storage.
You may want to decrease this parameter if your target machine
benefits from smaller stack usage.

translations.zh-CN:
线条编辑代码使用上-stack缓冲器进行存储.
如果您的目标机器, 您可能想要减少此参数
从较少的堆栈使用中受益。

55f31872d7b978545a6d30be08e464527d6a5c3d.english:
Enable vi-style line editing. In shells, this mode can be
turned on and off with "set -o vi" and "set +o vi".

translations.zh-CN:
启用 Vi 风格的行编辑 。 在贝壳中,此模式可以是:
打开和关闭的"set -ovi"和"set +ovi".
指定命令历史大小( 0 - 禁用) 。
在 shells 中启用历史保存 。

33382e3a7b2113f78899f776ad0a6c6ca45ceb0e.english: Save history on shell exit, not after every command

42d88658382578f244d607a6784434b014824b4b.english: Save history on shell exit, not after every command.

translations.zh-CN: 在 shell 退出时保存历史, 而不是在每个命令之后 。

b3aab8cee870a757bec53c66d68cdbeeec5fd447.english:
Enable readline-like Ctrl-R combination for reverse history search.
Increases code by about 0.5k.

translations.zh-CN:
启用类似读线的 Ctrl- R 组合进行反向历史搜索 。
增加代码约0.5k.
OpenWrt配置选项: Tab 完成.
OpenWrt配置选项:用户名完成.

085052fb9db7ed07694934437180977fd279b46d.english:
Setting this option allows for prompts to use things like \w and
\$ and escape codes.

translations.zh-CN:
设置此选项允许提示使用 &w 和
和逃生密码

91b86f0067375a2b9e3e9a208fae18dbee27e58f.english: Enable automatic tracking of window size changes

309bc4e80e664acea7d13d126e999f5542625d27.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable automatic tracking of window size changes.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用窗口大小变化的自动跟踪.

b418f566e6531f7ba411ea6cdc76831db8c889dc.english:
Allow usage of "ESC [ 6 n" sequence. Terminal answers back with
current cursor position. This information is used to make line
editing more robust in some cases.
If you are not sure whether your terminals respond to this code
correctly, or want to save on code size (about 400 bytes),
then do not turn this option on.

translations.zh-CN:
允许使用"ESC [6n] 序列. 终端回复方式
当前光标位置。 此信息用于线条
在某些情况下,编辑更加有力。
如果您不确定您的终端是否响应此代码
正确,或想要保存代码大小(约400字节),
然后不要打开此选项。

80bb0e1c5265e98fe373bb9e5a2fffe7aaa81e30.english: Enable locale support (system needs locale for this to work)

ffa3e2bdd1e6e114a6b0aa95f6a34a8cd70778a1.english:
Enable this if your system has locale support and you would like
busybox to support locale settings.

translations.zh-CN:
如果您的系统有 locate 支持并且您想要
支持语言设置的忙框 。

8ef197ec56b13f33fc1287e0cdb9114956096c5f.english:
This makes various applets aware that one byte is not
one character on screen.

Busybox aims to eventually work correctly with Unicode displays.
Any older encodings are not guaranteed to work.
Probably by the time when busybox will be fully Unicode-clean,
other encodings will be mainly of historic interest.

translations.zh-CN:
这使得各种小程序意识到一个字节不是
一个角色在屏幕上。

Busybox旨在最终与Unicode显示正确工作.
任何较旧的编码都无法保证有效。
等忙箱完全清空的时候
其他编码将主要具有历史意义。

9669db1e5d6454b72d05d7a429c5276508d2f4b1.english: Use libc routines for Unicode (else uses internal ones)

63d25b913a06ec0ec397b037d0da1860b13bfcf3.english:
With this option on, Unicode support is implemented using libc
routines. Otherwise, internal implementation is used.
Internal implementation is smaller.

translations.zh-CN:
启用此选项后, Unicode 支持会使用 libc 执行
常规。 否则,将采用内部执行。
内部执行较小。

eac0a12ec04bd5f3199159a3469bc4b0f4f6728b.english:
With this option on, Unicode support is activated
only if locale-related variables have the value of the form
"xxxx.utf8"

Otherwise, Unicode support will be always enabled and active.

translations.zh-CN:
启用此选项后, 启用 Unicode 支持
只有在与区域相关的变量具有窗体值的情况下
"xxx.utf8" (英语).

否则,Unicode支持将始终被启用和激活.

18d41f812530ae407a8b10b04d31cf5f97743a05.english: Character code to substitute unprintable characters with

bf3a3da8d2fd59c8961ba4086f6d4962e7394479.english:
Typical values are 63 for '?' (works with any output device),
30 for ASCII substitute control code,
65533 (0xfffd) for Unicode replacement character.

translations.zh-CN:
典型值为“?” 的63( 使用任何输出设备的工作),
30对ASCII替代控制码,
65533(0xfffd)用于Unicode替换字符.

cd12ffa354669eb2133718c17efe23729e0f2706.english:
Any character with Unicode value bigger than this is assumed
to be non-printable on output device. Many applets replace
such characters with substitution character.

The idea is that many valid printable Unicode chars
nevertheless are not displayed correctly. Think about
combining charachers, double-wide hieroglyphs, obscure
characters in dozens of ancient scripts...
Many terminals, terminal emulators, xterms etc will fail
to handle them correctly. Choose the smallest value
which suits your needs.

Typical values are:
126 - ASCII only
767 (0x2ff) - there are no combining chars in [0..767] range
(the range includes Latin 1, Latin Ext. A and B),
code is ~700 bytes smaller for this case.
4351 (0x10ff) - there are no double-wide chars in [0..4351] range,
code is ~300 bytes smaller for this case.
12799 (0x31ff) - nearly all non-ideographic characters are
available in [0..12799] range, including
East Asian scripts like katakana, hiragana, hangul,
bopomofo...
0 - off, any valid printable Unicode character will be printed.

translations.zh-CN:
任何字符的 Unicode 值大于此值的假设
用于输出设备上的不可打印。 许多小程序替换
带有替换字符的字符。

想法是许多有效的可打印 Unicode 字符
但显示的不正确。 考虑一下
混杂着杂技 双宽象形文字 模糊不清
数十个古代剧本中的字符...
许多终端、终端模拟器、 xterms 等将失败
以正确处理它们。 选择最小值
这适合你的需要。

典型值为:
126 - 仅使用ASCII
767 (0x2ff) - [0.767] 范围内没有组合字符
(范围包括拉丁语1,拉丁语Ext. (A和B节)
代码为~700字节。
4351(0x10ff) - 在[0.4351]范围内没有双宽字符,
代码为~300字节。
12799 (0x31ff) - 几乎所有非意识形态字符都是:
[0.1279] 范围,包括
东亚的剧本,如卡塔卡纳,希拉加纳,汉库尔,
宝波莫福...
0 - 关闭,任何有效的可打印的Unicode字符都将被打印出来.

3acb629ad44966b8329f7bb80cb2b542219ba2ee.english: Allow zero-width Unicode characters on output

51b8870c66917a0329f4848e2abda4c296878001.english:
With this option off, any Unicode char with width of 0
is substituted on output.

translations.zh-CN:
关闭此选项后, 任何宽度为 0 的 Unicode 字符
在输出上替换。

196dcb76e41c389a59e39b782054bc1278be9ec7.english: Allow wide Unicode characters on output

52e202254410b48e702f818c56ef898767763786.english:
With this option off, any Unicode char with width > 1
is substituted on output.

translations.zh-CN:
关闭此选项后, 任何宽 > 1 的 Unicode 字符
在输出上替换。

2843c763a08a4a8578103ea400c42a864b617e8e.english:
With this option on, right-to-left Unicode characters
are treated differently on input (e.g. cursor movement).

translations.zh-CN:
使用此选项, 右到左 Unicode 字符
在输入(例如光标移动)时会区别对待。

208af0e2ce39e47a48c9f2e27710acc2e0031714.english: In bidi input, support non-ASCII neutral chars too

e780decf38f6ec60dbdfd16e525e540841138cb1.english:
In most cases it's enough to treat only ASCII non-letters
(i.e. punctuation, numbers and space) as characters
with neutral directionality.
With this option on, more extensive (and bigger) table
of neutral chars will be used.

translations.zh-CN:
在大多数情况下,只处理ASCII非字母就足够了
(即标注、数字和空间)作为字符
具有中性的方向性.
有了这个选项, 更宽( 更大) 的桌子
将使用中性字符。

3da8416e64ba76eeda7b13e0ec22e66473b54e72.english: Make it possible to enter sequences of chars which are not Unicode

b25a7e0dd2113d66acdf5335525ca24ca11da506.english:
With this option on, on line-editing input (such as used by shells)
invalid UTF-8 bytes are not substituted with the selected
substitution character.
For example, this means that entering 'l', 's', ' ', 0xff, [Enter]
at shell prompt will list file named 0xff (single char name
with char value 255), not file named '?'.

translations.zh-CN:
启用此选项, 在行编辑输入上( 如贝壳使用)
无效的 UTF-8 字节不能被选中的替换
替换字符。
例如,这意味着输入'l','s','',0xff,[Enter]
在 shell 提示会列出名为 0xff 的文件( 单一字符名)
char 值为 255),而非名为“?”的文件。

2a8719ec314306c1764fc265eb658177b20e9454.english: Non-POSIX, but safer, copying to special nodes

0ef959cc668cb574b6cfc86a8733417e560a78fa.english:
With this option, "cp file symlink" will delete symlink
and create a regular file. This does not conform to POSIX,
but prevents a symlink attack.
Similarly, "cp file device" will not send file's data
to the device. (To do that, use "cat file >device")

translations.zh-CN:
使用此选项, “ cp 文件符号链接” 将删除 符号链接
并创建正则文件。 这不符合POSIX,
但防止连锁攻击
同样,“ cp 文件设备” 将不会发送文件的数据
到设备。 (为此,使用"猫文件 >device").

1051d26f5f586e5bc6c33422aa6033ce92328f9e.english: Give more precise messages when copy fails (cp, mv etc)

91c4ca4752904167d1cf7fede4a38da750e54ec4.english:
Error messages with this feature enabled:

$ cp file /does_not_exist/file
cp: cannot create '/does_not_exist/file': Path does not exist
$ cp file /vmlinuz/file
cp: cannot stat '/vmlinuz/file': Path has non-directory component

If this feature is not enabled, they will be, respectively:

cp: cannot create '/does_not_exist/file': No such file or directory
cp: cannot stat '/vmlinuz/file': Not a directory

This will cost you ~60 bytes.

translations.zh-CN:
启用此特性的错误信件 :

$ cp 文件 / does  not  sext/ file 中存在/文件
cp: 无法创建“/ does  not  sext/ file ” : 路径不存在
$ cp 文件 /vmlinuz/ 文件
cp: 无法 stat '/vmlinuz/ file' : 路径有非目录组件

如果无法启用此特性,它们分别是:

cp: 无法创建“/ does  not  sext/ file ” : 没有这样的文件或目录
cp: 无法 stat '/vmlinuz/ file' : 不是目录

这将花费你~60字节.

1385b1b458db1e94c0315d59663beedfaf225835.english:
When enabled, busybox will use the kernel sendfile() function
instead of read/write loops to copy data between file descriptors
(for example, cp command does this a lot).
If sendfile() doesn't work, copying code falls back to read/write
loop. sendfile() was originally implemented for faster I/O
from files to sockets, but since Linux 2.6.33 it was extended
to work for many more file types.

translations.zh-CN:
启用时, busybox 将使用内核发送文件 () 函数
而不是在文件描述符之间复制数据的读写循环
(例如,Cp命令经常这样做).
如果 sendfile () 无效, 复制代码会返回读/ 写入
loop. sendfile () 最初是用于更快 I/ 欧
从文件到套接字,但自Linux 2.6.33以来,它被扩展
要为更多文件类型工作。

80d4e35cf02032a291c4727f6971b1f97664fe5a.english:
Size of buffer used by cp, mv, install, wget etc.
Buffers which are 4 kb or less will be allocated on stack.
Bigger buffers will be allocated with mmap, with fallback to 4 kb
stack buffer if mmap fails.

translations.zh-CN:
cp,mv,安装,wget等使用的缓冲大小.
4 kb 或以下的缓冲将被分配到堆栈上。
较大的缓冲器将使用mmap分配,回落到4 kb
堆栈缓冲器, 如果 mmap 失败 。

b65c0fa10ffca54725dd97a21505a43fa4015e77.english:
Ignore rootfs entry in mount table.

In Linux, kernel has a special filesystem, rootfs, which is initially
mounted on /. It contains initramfs data, if kernel is configured
to have one. Usually, another file system is mounted over / early
in boot process, and therefore most tools which manipulate
mount table, such as df, will skip rootfs entry.

However, some systems do not mount anything on /.
If you need to configure busybox for one of these systems,
you may find it useful to turn this option off to make df show
initramfs statistics.

Otherwise, choose Y.

translations.zh-CN:
忽略挂载表格中的rootfs条目。

在Linux中,内核有一个特殊的文件系统rootfs,它最初是
安装于 /. 它包含 initramfs 数据, 如果内核配置
拥有一个。 通常,另一个文件系统挂载在 / 早期
在启动过程中,因此大多数工具可以操纵
df 等挂载表格将跳过 rootfs 条目 。

然而,有些系统没有在 / 上挂载任何东西.
如果你需要为其中一个系统配置繁忙框,
您可能会发现关闭此选项对 Df 显示有用
Initramfs统计。

否则,选择Y。

a06f6f43270d9a477bc379b2e8059af25023fcb3.english:
Use clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) syscall for measuring
time intervals (time, ping, traceroute etc need this).
Probably requires Linux 2.6+. If not selected, gettimeofday
will be used instead (which gives wrong results if date/time
is reset).

translations.zh-CN:
使用时钟  gettime( CLOCK  MONOTONIC) syscall 来测量
时间间隔(时间、ping、微径等都需要)
也许需要Linux 2.6+. 如果未选中, 则获得时间
将改为使用( 如果日期/ 时间给出错误的结果 )
重设中)。

e5e75cc2d2376262999ff356b0e46ef6a7ac8f57.english: Use ioctl names rather than hex values in error messages

2cd24e48f2aa277f5e466c2190b09340977c4099.english:
Use ioctl names rather than hex values in error messages
(e.g. VT_DISALLOCATE rather than 0x5608). If disabled this
saves about 1400 bytes.

translations.zh-CN:
在错误消息中使用ioctl 名称而不是十六进制值
(例如VT DISALOCATE 而不是 0x5608). 如果禁用此选项
保存了大约1400字节.

3b5dbfa3beb337758820aa623e0d4344cb9eb01c.english: Support for printing infiniband addresses in network applets.

translations.zh-CN: 支持在网络小程序中打印infiniband地址.

fab2b62ff58099b38078374394d50d17707c3287.english: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .xz data

c916a4cbe7f259b2bae87ed024e2950423bcdc02.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .xz data.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:使焦油,rpm,modprobe等能理解.xz数据.

fd1888619b11afff053d4e3c68db149dc762ef32.english: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .lzma data

6a371bd4456dd23fa7a634f47580d1fe74181a6b.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .lzma data.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:使tar,rpm,modprobe等理解.lzma数据.

c2d370a2011df207341961d753c7c28e3fcf7ffc.english: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .bz2 data

7bf34f0d3bdc40e4e06af8a058b4c7f8d570b48b.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .bz2 data.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:使tar,rpm,modprobe等理解.bz2数据.

7f3afc9bb1c2b10b67332497a6e36647232b951c.english: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .gz data

b354743fe51ec058385bf0fdd7e7037b10a28fa1.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .gz data.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:使tar,rpm,modprobe等理解.gz数据.

69768e3d5b951205edf8415ab9db27399a3bd3a2.english: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .Z data

2ff87e62086d63bcc8131dc9b3323e94aba48ddd.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Make tar, rpm, modprobe etc understand .Z data.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:使tar,rpm,modprobe等能理解.Z数据.

b433469f0559fc3f4d4dc139f6f231fd8f354620.english:
ar is an archival utility program used to create, modify, and
extract contents from archives. In practice, it is used exclusively
for object module archives used by compilers.

Unless you have a specific application which requires ar, you should
probably say N here: most compilers come with their own ar utility.

translations.zh-CN:
ar是用于创建,修改,和使用的存档工具程序.
从档案中提取内容。 在实践中,它只用于
用于编译器所用的对象模块档案。

除非您有特定的应用程序需要 AR,否则您应该
可能在这里说 N: 大部分编译器都带有自己的 ar 工具 。

c5d3d5245ffa1b704acb00c4150d4bb087cd1391.english: Support long filenames (not needed for debs)

82ba6c5ed309cad1d70c88e3d6ee5b62c1d5da6c.english:
By default the ar format can only store the first 15 characters
of the filename, this option removes that limitation.
It supports the GNU ar long filename method which moves multiple long
filenames into a the data section of a new ar entry.

translations.zh-CN:
默认情况下, ar格式只能存储前15个字符
在文件名中,此选项将删除该限制。
它支持移动多长的 GNU ar 长文件名方法
将文件名输入新 ar 项的数据部分。

fc199eb8aeed858694e4d1ba6ac8e08e9acd84d2.english: This enables archive creation (-c and -r) with busybox ar.

translations.zh-CN: 这样可以使用繁忙的box ar创建归档(-c和-r) 。

71d6dde158fe029f00a00902c34190df10d52551.english:
uncompress is used to decompress archives created by compress.
Not much used anymore, replaced by gzip/gunzip.

translations.zh-CN:
uncompress用于解压压缩创建的档案.
不再多用,改为gzip/gunzip.

72a6de8867834f59c790e95c1bd2a7da9cb50774.english:
gunzip is used to decompress archives created by gzip.
You can use the '-t' option to test the integrity of
an archive, without decompressing it.

translations.zh-CN:
gunzip用于解压gzip创建的档案.
您可以使用“ -t” 选项测试其完整性
一个档案,而不拆解它。
别用"gunzip -c".

2bb9cbe9c772d454d3da7673038c9006e1984f8f.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable long options.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用长选项.

7afcec6eb03269231466db6bddf3bb3d3be42904.english:
bunzip2 is a compression utility using the Burrows-Wheeler block
sorting text compression algorithm, and Huffman coding. Compression
is generally considerably better than that achieved by more
conventional LZ77/LZ78-based compressors, and approaches the
performance of the PPM family of statistical compressors.

Unless you have a specific application which requires bunzip2, you
should probably say N here.

translations.zh-CN:
bunzip2 是使用 Burrows- Wheeler 块的压缩工具
排序文本压缩算法和Huffman编码。 压缩
总体来说,比通过更多方法实现的要好得多。
常规LZ77/LZ78型压缩机,接近
统计压缩器系统业绩。

除非你有需要bunzip2的具体应用程序
应该应该说N在这里。
别用"bunzip2 -c"

9747bcd970304b5679bcb1a7a63bb2eb0baf2da1.english:
unlzma is a compression utility using the Lempel-Ziv-Markov chain
compression algorithm, and range coding. Compression
is generally considerably better than that achieved by the bzip2
compressors.

translations.zh-CN:
unlzma是一个使用Lempel-Ziv-Markov链的压缩工具
压缩算法,和范围编码. 压缩
通常比bzip2要好得多
压缩机.
别用"unlzma -c"

e903f009a2c65e1d9042e25977c2178207015ca1.english:
Enable this option if you want commands like "lzma -d" to work.
IOW: you'll get lzma applet, but it will always require -d option.

translations.zh-CN:
如果您想要像“ lzma - d” 这样的命令工作, 请启用此选项 。
IOW:你会得到lzma小程序,但它总是需要-d选项.
unxz是unlzma的继任者.

4b45bc7683a5d961230678082c911e950b73445d.english:
Enable this option if you want commands like "xz -d" to work.
IOW: you'll get xz applet, but it will always require -d option.

如果您想要像“ xz - d” 这样的命令起作用, 请启用此选项 。
IOW:你会得到xz小程序,但它总是需要-d选项.

07339919c0832de99532d7b2ef256b4c842025cb.english:
bzip2 is a compression utility using the Burrows-Wheeler block
sorting text compression algorithm, and Huffman coding. Compression
is generally considerably better than that achieved by more
conventional LZ77/LZ78-based compressors, and approaches the
performance of the PPM family of statistical compressors.

Unless you have a specific application which requires bzip2, you
should probably say N here.

translations.zh-CN:
bzip2是一种使用Burrows-Wheeler块的压缩工具
排序文本压缩算法和Huffman编码。 压缩
总体来说,比通过更多方法实现的要好得多。
常规LZ77/LZ78型压缩机,接近
统计压缩器系统业绩。

除非您有需要 bzip2 的特定应用程序
应该应该说N在这里。

cpio is an archival utility program used to create, modify, and
extract contents from archives.
cpio has 110 bytes of overheads for every stored file.

This implementation of cpio can extract cpio archives created in the
"newc" or "crc" format.

Unless you have a specific application which requires cpio, you
should probably say N here.

从档案中提取内容。
cpio对每个存储的文件都有110字节的间接费用.

应该应该说N在这里。

format only.

Cpio的这一实施可以在"newc"中创建cpio档案
格式。
通过模式。 很少使用过。

dpkg is a medium-level tool to install, build, remove and manage

dpkg 是安装、构建、删除和管理的中层工具

除非你有需要dpkg-deb的特定应用程序,

8ba31e32ec5be220ec8292669dd5c1a5f5ff7b9a.english:
System time can be set by 'date -s DATE' and simply 'date DATE',
but formats of DATE string are different. 'date DATE' accepts
a rather weird MMDDhhmm[[YY]YY][.ss] format with completely
unnatural placement of year between minutes and seconds.
date -s (and other commands like touch -d) use more sensible
formats (for one, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.ssssss).

With this option off, 'date DATE' and 'date -s DATE' support
the same format. With it on, 'date DATE' additionally supports
MMDDhhmm[[YY]YY][.ss] format.

translations.zh-CN:
系统时间可以通过“日期-s DATE”和简单的“日期DATE”来设定,
但DATE字符串的格式不同. “ 日期” 接受
一个相当奇怪的MMDDh hmm [YY] [.s] 格式,完全
非自然的放置年份 在分秒之间。
日期 -s(和诸如触摸 -d 等其他命令)使用更合理的
格式(一个是ISO格式YYY-MM-DD hh:mm:s.ssssssss)。

关闭此选项后, 使用“ date Date” 和“ date - s Date” 支持
同样的格式。 用它,“ date Date” 额外支持
[YYY] [.ss]格式。

10899206+0 records out

7a1598c525a317ec576f7f2c0d59eb63babfbf79.english:
The run-init utility is used from initramfs to select a new
root device. Under initramfs, you have to use this instead of
pivot_root.

Booting with initramfs extracts a gzipped cpio archive into rootfs
(which is a variant of ramfs/tmpfs). Because rootfs can't be moved
or unmounted, pivot_root will not work from initramfs. Instead,
run-init deletes everything out of rootfs (including itself),
does a mount --move that overmounts rootfs with the new root, and
then execs the specified init program.

util-linux has a similar tool, switch-root.
run-init differs by also having a "-d CAPS_TO_DROP" option.

translations.zh-CN:
从 initramfs 中选择新
根设备. 在initramfs下, 你必须用这个代替
(原始内容存档于2018-03-09). pict root.

(学名:Ramfs/tmpfs)为 ram科 ram属下的一个变种. 因为根子不能移动
或未挂载, pivot root 将无法从 initramfs 工作 。 相反,
run-init 从根部删除所有内容(包括本身),
运行一个挂载- 移动到根部上方, 并
然后执行指定的输入程序。

util-linux有类似的工具,切换根.

The vi undo functions can use an intermediate queue to greatly lower
malloc() calls and overhead. When the maximum size of this queue is
reached, the contents of the queue are committed to the undo stack.
This increases the size of the undo code and allows some undo
operations (especially un-typing/backspacing) to be far more useful.

这可以增加撤消代码的大小并允许一些撤消
操作(特别是不打字/回放)更有用。

52683d02c7fa534231ce44de622b9f44af02fb28.english:

Smaller values will create more undo objects and reduce the amount
of typed or backspaced characters that are grouped into one undo
operation; larger values increase the potential size of each undo
and will generally malloc() larger objects and less frequently.
Unless you want more (or less) frequent "undo points" while typing,
you should probably leave this unchanged.

并且一般会大于( ) 大于( ) 且频率较小 。

2eec97b0f0a0c67777a3fbd54064f5649d43005d.english:
bootchartd is commonly used to profile the boot process
for the purpose of speeding it up. In this case, it is started
by the kernel as the init process. This is configured by adding
the init=/sbin/bootchartd option to the kernel command line.

It can also be used to monitor the resource usage of a specific
application or the running system in general. In this case,
bootchartd is started interactively by running bootchartd start
and stopped using bootchartd stop.

translations.zh-CN:
启动图通常用于描述启动过程
为了加快速度 在这种情况下,它开始
以内核作为内核进程。 这是通过添加来配置
内核命令行的 init=/sbin/bootchart 选项。

也可以用来监测特定资源使用情况。
应用程序或运行中的系统。 在这种情况下,
启动图通过运行启动以交互方式启动
并停止使用靴子图停止。

e7ec6785e71c9415de71f33e63974c45381c6337.english:
Create extended header file compatible with "big" bootchartd.
"Big" bootchartd is a shell script and it dumps some
"convenient" info into the header, such as:
title = Boot chart for `hostname` (`date`)
system.uname = `uname -srvm`
system.release = `cat /etc/DISTRO-release`
system.cpu = `grep '^model name' /proc/cpuinfo | head -1` ($cpucount)
system.kernel.options = `cat /proc/cmdline`
This data is not mandatory for bootchart graph generation,
and is considered bloat. Nevertheless, this option
makes bootchartd applet to dump a subset of it.

translations.zh-CN:
创建与“ 大” 启动图兼容的扩展头文件 。
"大"的脚本是一个贝壳脚本 它丢掉一些
"方便"信息入头,如:
标题=`hostname`(`date`)的靴子图
系统.uname = `uname -srvm`
系统.释放=`cat /etc/DISTRO-release`
系统.cpu = `grep '^model name' /proc/cpuinfo | head -1` (美元)
系统.内核.选项=`cat /proc/cmdline`
这个数据对启动图的生成来说不是强制性的,
并被认为是bloat。 尽管如此,这个选择
制作拖曳图小程序以丢弃其中的一个子集。

58a0ec3cf1c29a6d19997f36311b56fb630674cf.english:

58b9a2b57d4cb427bf9270a35aceaf1e70cac093.english: Stop all processes and power off the system.

256623f70b38968f421434b634c7762076550c69.english: Before signaling init, make sure it is ready for it

cff0a798adc6a7e98b93f63d00ceca69ab15dbd5.english:
In rare cases, poweroff may be commanded by firmware to OS
even before init process exists. On Linux, this spawns
"/sbin/poweroff" very early. This option adds code
which checks that init is ready to receive poweroff
commands. Code size increase of ~80 bytes.

translations.zh-CN:
在极少数情况下,电源可能由固件命令OS
甚至在程序存在之前 在Linux上,这个产卵
"(/sbin/poweroff)"非常早. 此选项添加代码
检查它是否准备好接收电源
命令。 代码大小增加~80字节.

调用外部程序( 通常为电话) 以方便
切换到合适的运行级别。

此选项仅在您选择停止和朋友时可用,
但是没有选择它。

d2bbf6b1d56c446fb52a033919b9f3717b721522.english:

to facilitate proper shutdown, this path is to be used when
locating telinit executable.

找到可执行文件 。

556c3f4ebac9db6a24ca2dabecbdc48193b57c79.english: init is the first program run when the system boots.

translations.zh-CN: Init是系统靴子时第一个运行的程序.

5031610fc076dad13ae32ddcd849f2b655fa54cf.english: linuxrc: support running init from initrd (not initramfs)

8e799039003d50a449c2857833b67658dd49eae1.english:
Legacy support for running init under the old-style initrd. Allows
the name linuxrc to act as init, and it doesn't assume init is PID 1.

This does not apply to initramfs, which runs /init as PID 1 and
requires no special support.

translations.zh-CN:
遗产支持在旧式initrd下运行init. 允许
它不假设是PID 1。

这不适用于initramfs,它运行/init为PID 1和
不需要特别支持。

46c8a0272c0b9f44abccd851214c088fc4407d5d.english: Allow init to read an inittab file when the system boot.

translations.zh-CN: 允许在系统启动时读取 inittab 文件 。

561a7bc9c8d05a71ef5dfda4a24bd925116c9c88.english: Support killing processes that have been removed from inittab

d4866f201751f6e574a1efb8f4d6c96fe05671e5.english:
When respawn entries are removed from inittab and a SIGHUP is
sent to init, this option will make init kill the processes
that have been removed.

translations.zh-CN:
当重生条目从inittab 中移除时, 一个 SIGHUP 是
发送到 Init, 此选项会让 init 杀死进程
已经删除。

ece5f1ec9dbaf7c86b294e8a883debe766603fb0.english: How long to wait between TERM and KILL (0 - send TERM only)

d4017b9fd5c61dc48f305e38129543bab3ae09f8.english:
With nonzero setting, init sends TERM, forks, child waits N
seconds, sends KILL and exits. Setting it too high is unwise
(child will hang around for too long and could actually kill
the wrong process!)

translations.zh-CN:
在非零设置下, 它发送 TERM, 叉, 孩子等待 N
秒,发送KILL和退出。 设置太高是不明智的
(孩子会在这里呆太久,甚至会杀人)
错误的过程! )

be50dce48e7b1c97ec251815b8caf7fc9b12621b.english: Run commands with leading dash with controlling tty

6a9f3826fd3f27bb7f0752e9e96b790108b13b7a.english:
If this option is enabled, init will try to give a controlling
tty to any command which has leading hyphen (often it's "-/bin/sh").
More precisely, init will do "ioctl(STDIN_FILENO, TIOCSCTTY, 0)".
If device attached to STDIN_FILENO can be a ctty but is not yet
a ctty for other session, it will become this process' ctty.
This is not the traditional init behavour, but is often what you want
in an embedded system where the console is only accessed during
development or for maintenance.
NB: using cttyhack applet may work better.

translations.zh-CN:
如果启用此选项, 将尝试给定控制
tty 到任何带连字符的指令(通常为"-/bin/sh").
更确切地说,in将做"ioctl(STDIN FILENO,TIOCSCTY, 0)".
如果STDIN FILENO上附着的设备可以是 ctty 但不是
actty 对于其他会话, 它会成为这个过程的ctty。
这不是传统行为 而是你想要的
在嵌入式系统中,控制台只在使用期间访问
开发或维修。
NB:使用cttyhack小程序可能效果更好.

38b5248950beab826229495912abf1669acd85f3.english: Enable init to write to syslog

9aaa93ecb5ed77a90745d92949194e980c90093e.english:
If selected, some init messages are sent to syslog.
Otherwise, they are sent to VT #5 if linux virtual tty is detected
(if not, no separate logging is done).

translations.zh-CN:
如果选中的话, 一些 init 消息会被发送到 syslog 。
否则, 如果检测到 linux 虚拟 tty , 它们会被发送到 VT # 5
(如果没有,则不单独进行伐木)。

2b877d6076bf023f2a994c48e8df0631ef052503.english: Be quiet on boot (no 'init started:' message)

35f29496f2350e4e54139b9c5abbc295d6ce70c6.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Be quiet on boot (no 'init started:' message).

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt 配置选项: 在启动时保持安静( 没有“ init started: ” 消息) 。

93b032640bb8208d36ccfa4f1e71372a9af9407a.english: Support dumping core for child processes (debugging only)

7c5be4fd03d4d9536dd752be6fb5d42b86814746.english:
If this option is enabled and the file /.init_enable_core
exists, then init will call setrlimit() to allow unlimited
core file sizes. If this option is disabled, processes
will not generate any core files.

translations.zh-CN:
如果启用此选项并启用文件 /.init enable core
已存在,然后在其中调用设置限制( ) 以允许无限
核心文件大小。 如果此选项被禁用, 进程
将不生成任何核心文件。

efccfa7af5e34521785b6455c9f144b411258b66.english:
This is the initial value set by init for the TERM environment
variable. This variable is used by programs which make use of
extended terminal capabilities.

Note that on Linux, init attempts to detect serial terminal and
sets TERM to "vt102" if one is found.

translations.zh-CN:
这是由init为 TERM 环境设定的初始值
变量。 此变量被使用
延长终端能力。

请注意,在Linux上,它试图检测序列终端和
如果找到, TERM 设置为“ vt102 ” 。

c7d4df645d66c671de08b5d7ed4a6ca0ccfed24a.english:
When launched as PID 1 and after parsing its arguments, init
wipes all the arguments but argv[0] and rewrites argv[0] to
contain only "init", so that its command line appears solely as
"init" in tools such as ps.
If this option is set to Y, init will keep its original behavior,
otherwise, all the arguments including argv[0] will be preserved,
be they parsed or ignored by init.
The original command-line used to launch init can then be
retrieved in /proc/1/cmdline on Linux, for example.

translations.zh-CN:
当作为 PID 1 启动并解析其参数后, init
擦除所有参数, 但 argv[ 0] 并重写 argv[ 0] 至
只包含“ init ” , 因此其命令行仅显示为
ps等工具中的"init".
如果这个选项设定为 Y, 它会保持它的原始行为,
否则,所有论据,包括 argv[0] 都将保留下来,
或被它所忽视。
用于发射的原始命令行可以是
例如,在Linux上的/proc/1/cmdline中检索。

b85cc4f77b77bcfe4ddc3faf4ba69144823ed848.english:
Build support for shadow password in /etc/shadow. This file is only
readable by root and thus the encrypted passwords are no longer
publicly readable.

translations.zh-CN:
在/etc/shadow中建立对阴影密码的支持。 仅此文件
可用 root 读取, 因此加密的密码不再是
可公开阅读。

b8caa1bd77b48ce960fe9aeac5f38e0a434eb059.english: Use internal password and group functions rather than system functions

e140489db6b57aaa85a75485b39c61cebc344b38.english:
If you leave this disabled, busybox will use the system's password
and group functions. And if you are using the GNU C library
(glibc), you will then need to install the /etc/nsswitch.conf
configuration file and the required /lib/libnss_* libraries in
order for the password and group functions to work. This generally
makes your embedded system quite a bit larger.

Enabling this option will cause busybox to directly access the
system's /etc/password, /etc/group files (and your system will be
smaller, and I will get fewer emails asking about how glibc NSS
works). When this option is enabled, you will not be able to use
PAM to access remote LDAP password servers and whatnot. And if you
want hostname resolution to work with glibc, you still need the
/lib/libnss_* libraries.

If you need to use glibc's nsswitch.conf mechanism
(e.g. if user/group database is NOT stored in /etc/passwd etc),
you must NOT use this option.

If you enable this option, it will add about 1.5k.

translations.zh-CN:
如果您离开此禁用, 忙框会使用系统的密码
和组函数。 如果您正在使用 GNU C 库
(glibc),然后需要安装 /etc/nsswitch.conf
配置文件和所需的 /libnss * 库
命令,使密码和组函数工作。 一般来说
让你的嵌入式系统大得多

启用此选项将导致忙框直接访问
系统的/etc/password,/etc/组文件(而您的系统将是
更小,我会得到更少的电子邮件 问如何glibc NSS
(见A/CN.9/WG.III/WP.1号文件)。 当启用此选项时, 您将无法使用
访问远程 LDAP 密码服务器的 PAM 。 狦
要使用 glibc 处理主机名解析度, 您还需要
/lib/libnss * 图书馆.

bd85fe023f29cd485447a1d8e1a95960e44ebd4a.english:
Busybox has internal DES and MD5 crypt functions.
They produce results which are identical to corresponding
standard C library functions.

If you leave this disabled, busybox will use the system's
crypt functions. Most C libraries use large (~70k)
static buffers there, and also combine them with more general
DES encryption/decryption.

For busybox, having large static buffers is undesirable,
especially on NOMMU machines. Busybox also doesn't need
DES encryption/decryption and can do with smaller code.

If you enable this option, it will add about 4.8k of code
if you are building dynamically linked executable.
In static build, it makes code _smaller_ by about 1.2k,
and likely many kilobytes less of bss.

Build smaller (~1.5 kbytes), simplified module tools.

This option by itself does not enable any applets -

With this option modprobe does not require modules.dep file
and does not use /etc/modules.conf file.
It scans module files in /lib/modules/`uname -r` and
determines dependencies and module alias names on the fly.
This may make module loading slower, most notably
when one needs to load module by alias (this requires
scanning through module _bodies_).

At the first attempt to load a module by alias modprobe
will try to generate modules.dep.bb file in order to speed up
future loads by alias. Failure to do so (read-only /lib/modules,
etc) is not reported, and future modprobes will be slow too.

NB: modules.dep.bb file format is not compatible
with modules.dep file as created/used by standard module tools.

Additional module parameters can be stored in
/etc/modules/$module_name files.

7330f88182404c40376dcb9a25fbbb63a959e5df.english: Try to load module from a mmap'ed area

f092ea429fedb3089f3878d5d6cb7e1bab080645.english:
This option causes module loading code to try to mmap
module first. If it does not work (for example,
it does not work for compressed modules), module will be read
(and unpacked if needed) into a memory block allocated by malloc.

The only case when mmap works but malloc does not is when
you are trying to load a big module on a very memory-constrained
machine. Malloc will momentarily need 2x as much memory as mmap.

Choosing N saves about 250 bytes of code (on 32-bit x86).

机器 机器 电脑 马洛克马上需要2x的记忆 和mmap一样多

Choosing N节省了大约250字节的代码(在32位x86上).

2498d98cccaa0a74fc87690ba768f4be02e3411a.english:
acpid listens to ACPI events coming either in textual form from
/proc/acpi/event (though it is marked deprecated it is still widely
used and _is_ a standard) or in binary form from specified evdevs
(just use /dev/input/event*).

It parses the event to retrieve ACTION and a possible PARAMETER.
It then spawns /etc/acpi/<ACTION>[/<PARAMETER>] either via run-parts
(if the resulting path is a directory) or directly as an executable.

N.B. acpid relies on run-parts so have the latter installed.

translations.zh-CN:

/proc/appi/event(虽然它被标记为贬值,但仍然广泛)

(只是使用/dev/投入/活动*).

它描述了获取 Action 和可能的 PARAMETER 的事件。
然后通过运行部分产生/etc/appi/<ACTION>[/<PARAMETER>]
(如果由此产生的路径是目录)或直接作为可执行文件.

N.B. apid依赖于运行部件,后者也安装了。
接受并忽略兼容性选项 -g -m -s -S -v.

wish to enable the 'dmesg' utility.

fdflush is only needed when changing media on slightly-broken
removable media drives. It is used to make Linux believe that a
hardware disk-change switch has been actuated, which causes Linux to
forget anything it has cached from the previous media. If you have
such a slightly-broken drive, you will need to run fdflush every time
you change a disk. Most people have working hardware and can safely
leave this disabled.

pivot_root, you may want to free the memory that is allocated to the
ramdisk. If you have no use for freeing memory from a ramdisk, leave
this disabled.

604cb18286e091f2c0c9b7bc0c3e217d3fcaf068.english:
The switch_root utility is used from initramfs to select a new
root device. Under initramfs, you have to use this instead of
pivot_root. (Stop reading here if you don't care why.)

Booting with initramfs extracts a gzipped cpio archive into rootfs
(which is a variant of ramfs/tmpfs). Because rootfs can't be moved
or unmounted*, pivot_root will not work from initramfs. Instead,
switch_root deletes everything out of rootfs (including itself),
does a mount --move that overmounts rootfs with the new root, and
then execs the specified init program.

* Because the Linux kernel uses rootfs internally as the starting
and ending point for searching through the kernel's doubly linked
list of active mount points. That's why.

从 initramfs 中选择新的切换  root 工具

(原始内容存档于2018-03-09). pict root. (如果你不在乎为什么就别在这里看)

以 initramfs 启动 提取 gzipped cpio 归档为 rootfs

或未挂载 *, pivot root 将无法从 initramfs 工作 。 相反,
切换 root 删除所有rootfs(包括自身),
运行一个挂载- 移动到根部上方, 并

* 因为Linux内核在内部使用rootfs作为起始
通过内核双链接搜索的结束点
列出活动挂载点。 故说.

device.

You can still use the 'losetup' utility (to manually associate files

specify an offset or cryptographic options to the loopback device.
(If you don't want umount to free the loop device, use "umount -D".)

3a7c341298b8e1ce35f5a0ce0fad94f17da68fb0.english:
Historically, Unix systems kept track of the currently mounted
partitions in the file "/etc/mtab". These days, the kernel exports
the list of currently mounted partitions in "/proc/mounts", rendering
the old mtab file obsolete. (In modern systems, /etc/mtab should be
a symlink to /proc/mounts.)

The only reason to have mount maintain an /etc/mtab file itself is if
your stripped-down embedded system does not have a /proc directory.
If you must use this, keep in mind it's inherently brittle (for
example a mount under chroot won't update it), can't handle modern
features like separate per-process filesystem namespaces, requires
that your /etc directory be writable, tends to get easily confused
by --bind or --move mounts, won't update if you rename a directory
that contains a mount point, and so on. (In brief: avoid.)

About the only reason to use this is if you've removed /proc from
your kernel.

你的内核。

0ac2f390872e0634e755893ff0d282962eb58d26.english:
bc is a command-line, arbitrary-precision calculator with a
Turing-complete language. See the GNU bc manual
(https://www.gnu.org/software/bc/manual/bc.html) and bc spec
(http://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/utilities/bc.html).

This bc has five differences to the GNU bc:
1) The period (.) is a shortcut for "last", as in the BSD bc.
2) Arrays are copied before being passed as arguments to
functions. This behavior is required by the bc spec.
3) Arrays can be passed to the builtin "length" function to get
the number of elements in the array. This prints "1":
a[0] = 0; length(a[])
4) The precedence of the boolean "not" operator (!) is equal to
that of the unary minus (-) negation operator. This still
allows POSIX-compliant scripts to work while somewhat
preserving expected behavior (versus C) and making parsing
easier.
5) "read()" accepts expressions, not only numeric literals.

5f533b6d710406dc616aa3062123d676e9bc7312.english:
dc is a reverse-polish notation command-line calculator which
supports unlimited precision arithmetic. See the FreeBSD man page
(https://www.unix.com/man-page/FreeBSD/1/dc/) and GNU dc manual
(https://www.gnu.org/software/bc/manual/dc-1.05/html_mono/dc.html).

This dc has a few differences from the two above:
1) When printing a byte stream (command "P"), this dc follows what
the FreeBSD dc does.
2) Implements the GNU extensions for divmod ("~") and
modular exponentiation ("|").
3) Implements all FreeBSD extensions, except for "J" and "M".
4) Like the FreeBSD dc, this dc supports extended registers.
However, they are implemented differently. When it encounters
whitespace where a register should be, it skips the whitespace.
If the character following is not a lowercase letter, an error
is issued. Otherwise, the register name is parsed by the
following regex: [a-z][a-z0-9_]*
This generally means that register names will be surrounded by
whitespace. Examples:
l idx s temp L index S temp2 < do_thing
Also note that, like the FreeBSD dc, extended registers are not
allowed unless the "-x" option is given.

or executables before they are used. When used at the right time
(in particular when a CPU bound process is running) it can
significantly speed up system startup.

As readahead(2) blocks until each file has been read, it is best to
run this applet as a background job.

或可执行文件在使用前。 当在正确的时间使用时
