你可能想说N

ed3e00fd4456a7a5305ed73a11c58cbfb1e7044b.english: Prefer IPv4 addresses from DNS queries

4cc4e08b3d6bc09fe1d650efa85f3aba42a7d35c.english:
Use IPv4 address of network host if it has one.

If this option is off, the first returned address will be used.
This may cause problems when your DNS server is IPv6-capable and
is returning IPv6 host addresses too. If IPv6 address
precedes IPv4 one in DNS reply, busybox network applets
(e.g. wget) will use IPv6 address. On an IPv6-incapable host
or network applets will fail to connect to the host
using IPv6 address.

translations.zh-CN:
如果网络主机有IPv4地址,则使用该地址.

如果关闭此选项, 将使用第一个返回的地址 。
当您的 DNS 服务器具有 IPv6 能力且
正在返回 IPv6 主机地址 。 如果 IPv6 地址
在 DNS 回复中先于 IPv4 1, 忙箱网络小程序
(例如wget)将使用IPv6地址. 在 IPv6 无法主机上
或网络小程序无法连接到主机
使用 IPv6 地址。

5a209358e6c926aee64f6b8affc436ff37d25f2e.english:
Enable if you are not satisfied with simplistic
"can't resolve 'hostname.com'" and want to know more.
This may increase size of your executable a bit.

translations.zh-CN:
如果您对简单化不满意, 则启用
"不能解决'hostname.com'" 想知道更多.
这可能会增加您可执行文件的大小 。

4a26c06fcb09dabf21bc578a18d46b1584ab61f3.english: In TLS code, support ciphers which use deprecated SHA1

f4b25a74c712f2ed4c6ec83f4f919021a077b28b.english:
Selecting this option increases interoperability with very old
servers, but slightly increases code size.

Most TLS servers support SHA256 today (2018), since SHA1 is
considered possibly insecure (although not yet definitely broken).

translations.zh-CN:
选择此选项会增加非常旧的互操作性
服务器,但略微增加代码大小.

今天(2018年)大多数TLS服务器支持SHA256,因为SHA1是
认为可能不安全(虽然尚未完全打破)。
操纵系统ARP缓存.
由ARP包装的Ping主机.

21ec5dc4c037c7df1291791ff5cfe90e2b8f5dd9.english:
Manage ethernet bridges.
Supports addbr/delbr and addif/delif.

translations.zh-CN:
管理醚网桥.
支持添加br/delbr和添加if/delif。

5fc42d132b7c01a52facbda635e73fd3c487a193.english:
Add support for extended option like:
setageing, setfd, sethello, setmaxage,
setpathcost, setportprio, setbridgeprio,
stp
This adds about 600 bytes.

translations.zh-CN:
添加对扩展选项的支持, 如 :
设置、设置、设置、设置、设置
Setpathcost, setportprio, setbridgeprio, 斯特布里奇普里奥,
标准
这增加了大约600字节.

e8a0e330e41b6439ce4a0aaa653034fc7c47e84d.english:
Add support for option which prints the current config:
show

translations.zh-CN:
为打印当前配置的选项添加支持 :
显示

3e742894fafcf2f5ff6da25af02b9800ea3a354c.english: Small and static DNS server daemon.

translations.zh-CN: 小而静态的DNS服务器守护进程.

3a0eaa9583bb6cb2949af8dfbbac3086cd39e7e2.english: Send a magic packet to wake up sleeping machines.

translations.zh-CN: 发送一个魔法包 醒来睡觉机器。

82640146b2d52e09531ee81ad2abcbb8d2bc3f2e.english: Simple FTP daemon. You have to run it via inetd.

translations.zh-CN: 简单的 FTP 守护进程 。 你必须通过输入运行它。

d6920bed21498b23245e9ac85d426056bd24acf7.english:
Enable -w option. "ftpd -w" will accept upload commands
such as STOR, STOU, APPE, DELE, MKD, RMD, rename commands.

translations.zh-CN:
启用 -w 选项 。 ftpd -w" 将接受上传命令
例如STOR,STOU,APPE,DEELE,MKD,RMD,重命名命令.

ca9c024d4166a991a8d18da721be5b5dbe8fec42.english:
Some ftp clients (among them KDE's Konqueror) issue illegal
"LIST -l" requests. This option works around such problems.
It might prevent you from listing files starting with "-" and
it increases the code size by ~40 bytes.
Most other ftp servers seem to behave similar to this.

translations.zh-CN:
一些 ftp 客户端( 包括 KDE 的 Konqueror) 发行非法
"LIST -l"请求. 这一方案围绕这些问题发挥作用。
这可能会妨碍您从“ -”开始列出文件
它使代码大小增加了~40字节.
大部分其他的ftp服务器似乎都与此相似.

74d32c59d030bb787f237921633247118424cb76.english:
Require login, and change to logged in user's UID:GID before
accessing any files. Option "-a USER" allows "anonymous"
logins (treats them as if USER logged in).

If this option is not selected, ftpd runs with the rights
of the user it was started under, and does not require login.
Take care to not launch it under root.

translations.zh-CN:
需要登录, 在用户的 UID: GID 之前更改为登录
访问任何文件。 选项“ a USER” 允许“ 匿名”
登录( 把它们当作 USER 登录) 。

如果不选中此选项, ftpd 将随权限运行
,不需要登录。
注意不要在根下发射.

4b29d158dc8bca398131e017f194c5ef0ce91c41.english: Retrieve a remote file via FTP.

translations.zh-CN: 通过 FTP 获取远程文件 。

36556c2fa01a49f8e6ceb0d76ecbd62a3e5608de.english: Store a remote file via FTP.

translations.zh-CN: 通过 FTP 存储远程文件 。

25dee337a164495649d6d4c4e4ec9171370cf6aa.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable long options in ftpget/ftpput.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:在ftpget/ftpput中启用长选项.

2c1f5806d18320130273be31b79ad3c5bf782a9b.english: Show or set the system's host name.

translations.zh-CN: 显示或设置系统的主机名 。
别用"主机名 -d"
HTTP 服务器.

4476134cde95f6361d67379b7b5dce2e06d4e3ba.english:
Makes httpd emit "Accept-Ranges: bytes" header and understand
"Range: bytes=NNN-[MMM]" header. Allows for resuming interrupted
downloads, seeking in multimedia players etc.

translations.zh-CN:
使 httpd 发布“ 接受范围: 字节” 标题并理解
"Range:字节=NNN-[MMM]"标题. 允许恢复中断
下载,在多媒体播放器中查找等.

dc8057f2f9ccc2b9355de613ae8199c75a9beb4d.english:
This option allows the server to run as a specific user
rather than defaulting to the user that starts the server.
Use of this option requires special privileges to change to a
different user.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许服务器作为特定用户运行
而不是默认启动服务器的用户。
使用此选项需要特殊特权才能更改为
不同的用户。

773d073dc7238eaad2569d1b3bad291af87da819.english:
Utilizes password settings from /etc/httpd.conf for basic
authentication on a per url basis.
Example for httpd.conf file:
/adm:toor:PaSsWd

translations.zh-CN:
使用 /etc/httpd.conf 的密码设置进行基础
每个 URL 认证 。
httpd.conf文件示例 :
/adm:toor:PASWd (中文(简体) ).

9317a2aa05d3af50185a6a62e8a539ad1df9b4ad.english: Support MD5-encrypted passwords in HTTP authentication

3eba278e36a9853b152be5d5ae90d6170d18df53.english:
Enables encrypted passwords, and wildcard user/passwords
in httpd.conf file.
User '*' means 'any system user name is ok',
password of '*' means 'use system password for this user'
Examples:
/adm:toor:$1$P/eKnWXS$aI1aPGxT.dJD5SzqAKWrF0
/adm:root:*
/wiki:*:*

translations.zh-CN:
启用加密密码和通配符用户/密码
在 httpd.conf 文件中。
用户 '*' 表示“ 任何系统用户名都行 ” ,
'*' 的密码表示“ 该用户使用系统密码 ”
实例:
/adm:toor:$1P/eKnWXS$aI1aPGxT.dJD5SzqAKWrF0 (中文(简体) ).
/ adm: root: * (中文(简体) ).
/维基:*:*

750ffc2cae3590f5803f66c75c3fc775dbd68ab6.english:
This option allows scripts and executables to be invoked
when specific URLs are requested.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许引用脚本和可执行文件
当请求特定的 URL 时。

35d3b439ef76beeb07d6e62d9cf27a246378a755.english: Support running scripts through an interpreter

82aa6d17dec1e1cc0c9ce4c786f600bb96ad7506.english:
This option enables support for running scripts through an
interpreter. Turn this on if you want PHP scripts to work
properly. You need to supply an additional line in your
httpd.conf file:
*.php:/path/to/your/php

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许支持通过一个
翻译。 如果您想要 PHP 脚本工作, 请打开此选项
适当。 您需要额外提供一条线路
httpd.conf 文件 :
*.php:/路径/到你/php

299eda04ed1ab87561924b1bcd67df5e8b0549d7.english: Set REMOTE_PORT environment variable for CGI

47bc31a67df0a4fca80584d16efffd2221842595.english:
Use of this option can assist scripts in generating
references that contain a unique port number.

translations.zh-CN:
使用此选项可以帮助脚本生成
包含唯一端口号码的引用。

b68dae05d1baa8636f22dff47004b22e887249de.english: Enable -e option (useful for CGIs written as shell scripts)

ee4258e2e69a5c16e329c312a4bf22b5da18b207.english:
This option allows html encoding of arbitrary strings for display
by the browser. Output goes to stdout.
For example, httpd -e "<Hello World>" produces
"&#60Hello&#32World&#62".

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许 html 任意字符串编码以显示
由浏览器。 输出到Stdout。
例如, httpd -e "Hello World" 生成
"##60 Hello###32 World##62".

af01605847b919028b4d8d380d602a9021543916.english:
This option allows you to define custom error pages in
the configuration file instead of the default HTTP status
error pages. For instance, if you add the line:
E404:/path/e404.html
in the config file, the server will respond the specified
'/path/e404.html' file instead of the terse '404 NOT FOUND'
message.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许您定义自定义错误页面
配置文件而不是默认的 HTTP 状态
错误页 。 例如,如果添加该行:
E404:/path/e404.html (中文(简体) ).
在配置文件中,服务器将响应指定的
“ / path/ e404. html” 文件代替“ 404 Not FOUND ”
留言。

24dc96dd13936a1853dedf42fb9da516c939d98c.english:
This option allows you to define URLs that will be forwarded
to another HTTP server. To setup add the following line to the
configuration file
P:/url/:http://hostname[:port]/new/path/
Then a request to /url/myfile will be forwarded to
http://hostname[:port]/new/path/myfile.

95f82f269a5e74fd87c5313851c535863c5b224f.english:
Makes httpd send files using GZIP content encoding if the
client supports it and a pre-compressed <file>.gz exists.

translations.zh-CN:
使 httpd 使用 GZIP 内容编码发送文件, 如果
客户端支持它,预压缩的<file>.gz存在.

e3718b6b90932c96b29454724b3b9d97caaa92f9.english:
If server responds with ETag then next time client (browser)
resend it via If-None-Match header.
Then httpd will check if file wasn't modified and if not,
return 304 Not Modified status code.
The ETag value is constructed from last modification date
in unix epoch, and size: "hex(last_mod)-hex(file_size)".
It's not completely reliable as hash functions but fair enough.

translations.zh-CN:
如果服务器响应ETag, 那么下一次客户端( 浏览器)
通过 If-None-Match 标题重新发送 。
然后httpd会检查文件是否没有修改,如果没有修改,
返回 304 非修改状态代码。
ETag 值从上次修改日期构建
在 unix 时代,和大小 : “ hex( last mod)- hex( file  size) ” 。
它不完全可靠 作为散列函数 但足够公平。

abd25c991ff48bc15ca40f104b6830bdc2011f78.english:
The Last-Modified header is used for cache validation.
The client sends last seen mtime to server in If-Modified-Since.
Both headers MUST be an RFC 1123 formatted, which is hard to parse.
Use ETag header instead.

translations.zh-CN:
最后修改后的标题用于缓存验证.
客户端向 If-Modified-Since 服务器发送最后看到的时间 。
两个头头MUST都是RFC 1123格式化的,很难解析.
使用 ETag 头来代替 。

687c02e0b61bd083468b98517a7be8dc35f24c3f.english:
RFC2616 says that server MUST add Date header to response.
But it is almost useless and can be omitted.

translations.zh-CN:
RFC2616表示服务器MUST在响应中增加了Date头.
但它几乎毫无用处,可以省略。
支持 IP 拒绝/ 允许规则

bf1f205d1384991f59dfebbfe2a3cb97b317b81c.english: Ifconfig is used to configure the kernel-resident network interfaces.

translations.zh-CN: Ifconfig用于配置内核-居民网络接口.

09252745173b3217da6af9dc812bfcfe0f6bdadc.english:
If ifconfig is called with no arguments it will display the status
of the currently active interfaces.

translations.zh-CN:
如果调用没有参数的配置, 则显示状态
用于当前活动接口。

ba3f5a72585b30939a734b46dd5eaf90b948e89e.english:
Allow "keepalive" and "outfill" support for SLIP. If you're not
planning on using serial lines, leave this unchecked.

translations.zh-CN:
允许 SLIP 支持“ 保留” 和“ 外充” 。 如果你没有
计划使用序列线, 留下这个不受限制。

691fad6b2a56d40abab0b0158a258263ed1063bc.english:
Allow the start address for shared memory, start address for I/O,
and/or the interrupt line used by the specified device.

translations.zh-CN:
允许共享内存的起始地址, I/O的起始地址,
和/或指定设备所使用的中断行。

d454e0c9b4a11210b3c19f102d139bc9d63a2b1f.english:
Set the hardware address of this interface, if the device driver
supports  this  operation. Currently, we only support the 'ether'
class.

translations.zh-CN:
如果设备驱动程序设置此接口的硬件地址
支持此操作。 目前,我们只支持‘ether'
课。

a566494efce889a096d986dd595942cdf2842286.english:
Setting this will make ifconfig attempt to find the broadcast
automatically if the value '+' is used.

translations.zh-CN:
设置此选项会让配置尝试查找广播
如果使用“+”值,则自动。

c6a06e4a305b3e8b4d520d74db443a90d42aa9a5.english:
Userspace application to bind several interfaces
to a logical interface (use with kernel bonding driver).

translations.zh-CN:
绑定多个接口的用户空间应用程序
到逻辑接口(使用内核连接驱动程序)。
网络接口插件检测守护进程.

516a8db5cf116c2ca9a75a98f896feae68fec6f0.english:
Activate the specified interfaces. This applet makes use
of either "ifconfig" and "route" or the "ip" command to actually
configure network interfaces. Therefore, you will probably also want
to enable either IFCONFIG and ROUTE, or enable
FEATURE_IFUPDOWN_IP and the various IP options. Of
course you could use non-busybox versions of these programs, so
against my better judgement (since this will surely result in plenty
of support questions on the mailing list), I do not force you to
enable these additional options. It is up to you to supply either
"ifconfig", "route" and "run-parts" or the "ip" command, either
via busybox or via standalone utilities.

translations.zh-CN:
激活指定的接口。 这个小程序有用
或“ ifconfig” 和“ route” 或“ ip” 命令
配置网络接口 。 因此,你可能会想要
或启用
FEATURE IFUPDOWN IP和各种IP选项. 员额
课程中您可以使用这些程序的非 busybox 版本,所以
以我更好的判断(因为这样必定能使人
我并不强迫你
启用这些附加选项。 也由你来提供
"ifconfig","route"和"run-parts"或"ip"命令,无论是
通过忙箱或单独的公用事业。
取消指定的接口。

7449a8a91e7f0d97773574606ae2a32d94835719.english:
ifupdown keeps state information in a file called ifstate.
Typically it is located in /var/run/ifstate, however
some distributions tend to put it in other places
(debian, for example, uses /etc/network/run/ifstate).
This config option defines location of ifstate.

translations.zh-CN:
ifupdown将状态信息保存在名为ifstate的文件。
不过,它通常位于/var/run/ifstate。
有些分布倾向于放在其他地方
(例如debian使用/etc/network/run/ifstate).
此配置选项定义了 ifstate 的位置 。

5138fce242d23a4744299fc190fa25c8bfbadebb.english: Use ip tool (else ifconfig/route is used)

48fe37def6cdea116593afd6b0edfd5f55d420ce.english:
Use the iproute "ip" command to implement "ifup" and "ifdown", rather
than the default of using the older "ifconfig" and "route" utilities.

If Y: you must install either the full-blown iproute2 package
or enable "ip" applet in busybox, or the "ifup" and "ifdown" applets
will not work.

If N: you must install either the full-blown ifconfig and route
utilities, or enable these applets in busybox.

translations.zh-CN:
使用 iprout "ip" 命令来实施 “ ifup” 和 “ ifdown ” , 相反
而不是默认使用旧的“ifconfig”和“route”公用事业。

如果 Y : 您必须安装全部 iproute2 包
或启用忙箱中的“ ip” 小程序, 或是“ ifup” 和“ ifdown” 小程序
将不工作。

如果 N: 您必须安装完整配置和路由
公用设备, 或者启用这些小程序在繁忙框中 。

f652af771aeb63ee5d35b70f286d86c1cc36d2b5.english: If you want ifup/ifdown to talk IPv4, leave this on.

translations.zh-CN: 如果你想说IPv4的话,请打开它

c85330bfaa9d5a17911776bd48956f39b3255a1e.english: If you need support for IPv6, turn this option on.

translations.zh-CN: 如果您需要 IPv6 的支持, 请打开此选项 。

0365d47de9743ff6dac681a939950d62610749d8.english:
This enables support for the "mapping" stanza, unless you have
a weird network setup you don't need it.

translations.zh-CN:
它可以支持“ 映射” stanza, 除非你有
一个奇怪的网络设置 你不需要它。

ad2dd5f473044406c54c3fefd0825677813abc31.english:
This enables support for the external dhcp clients. Clients are
tried in the following order: dhcpcd, dhclient, pump and udhcpc.
Otherwise, if udhcpc applet is enabled, it is used.
Otherwise, ifup/ifdown will have no support for DHCP.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以支持外部 dhcp 客户端 。 客户是
dhcpcd、dhclient、泵和 udhcpc。
否则,如果启用 udhcpc 小程序,则使用.
否则,如果上下游将得不到DHCP的支持.
互联网超级服务器守护进程

3fc9a8e36493bec54cada15dfe5d82550b8a1f88.english:
Internal service which echoes data back.
Activated by configuration lines like these:
echo stream tcp nowait root internal
echo dgram  udp wait   root internal

translations.zh-CN:
内部服务 回溯数据。
通过这样的配置线激活 :
回声流 tcp 不等待 root 内部
内部回声 dgram udp 等待根

8c30b82f8fb02fa7d98c906009f4dacee952e44c.english:
Internal service which discards all input.
Activated by configuration lines like these:
discard stream tcp nowait root internal
discard dgram  udp wait   root internal

translations.zh-CN:
放弃所有输入的内部服务 。
通过这样的配置线激活 :
丢弃流 tcp 不等待 root 内部
丢弃 dgram udp 等待内部根

e86f4afb3d469948839a4c8ab45c5a21869e0f3d.english:
Internal service which returns big-endian 32-bit number
of seconds passed since 1900-01-01. The number wraps around
on overflow.
Activated by configuration lines like these:
time stream tcp nowait root internal
time dgram  udp wait   root internal

translations.zh-CN:
返回大端32位数的内部服务
1900-01-01以来的几秒钟。 数字环绕
在溢出时。
通过这样的配置线激活 :
时间流 tcp 不等待 root 内部
时间 dgram udp 等待 root 内部

deaf1ce900673c3e5a991ba07d178f3215f51f0d.english:
Internal service which returns human-readable time.
Activated by configuration lines like these:
daytime stream tcp nowait root internal
daytime dgram  udp wait   root internal

translations.zh-CN:
内部服务 返回人可读的时间。
通过这样的配置线激活 :
白天流 tcp 不等待 root 内部
日间 dgram udp 等待 root 内部

b1e22638656b82516bf022b509dafa4c6135a3e5.english:
Internal service which generates endless stream
of all ASCII chars beetween space and char 126.
Activated by configuration lines like these:
chargen stream tcp nowait root internal
chargen dgram  udp wait   root internal

translations.zh-CN:
产生无尽流的内部服务
在ASCII所有甜点空间和Char 126中
通过这样的配置线激活 :
充电流 tcp 不等待根内部
充电 dgram udp 等待内部根
支持基于太阳的RPC服务

a3e090c5f1f673cae6d5f0891f00770477cec7c3.english:
The "ip" applet is a TCP/IP interface configuration and routing
utility.
Short forms (enabled below) are busybox-specific extensions.
The standard "ip" utility does not provide them. If you are
trying to be portable, it's better to use "ip CMD" forms.

translations.zh-CN:

fa16c44cac10daf7dccda848f638a764f17266d2.english:
A daemon for the TELNET protocol, allowing you to log onto the host
running the daemon. Please keep in mind that the TELNET protocol
sends passwords in plain text. If you can't afford the space for an
SSH daemon and you trust your network, you may say 'y' here. As a
more secure alternative, you should seriously consider installing the
very small Dropbear SSH daemon instead:
http://matt.ucc.asn.au/dropbear/dropbear.html

Note that for busybox telnetd to work you need several things:
First of all, your kernel needs:
CONFIG_UNIX98_PTYS=y

Next, you need a /dev/pts directory on your root filesystem:

$ ls -ld /dev/pts
drwxr-xr-x  2 root root 0 Sep 23 13:21 /dev/pts/

Next you need the pseudo terminal master multiplexer /dev/ptmx:

$ ls -la /dev/ptmx
crw-rw-rw-  1 root tty 5, 2 Sep 23 13:55 /dev/ptmx

Any /dev/ttyp[0-9]* files you may have can be removed.
Next, you need to mount the devpts filesystem on /dev/pts using:

mount -t devpts devpts /dev/pts

You need to be sure that busybox has LOGIN and
FEATURE_SUID enabled. And finally, you should make
certain that busybox has been installed setuid root:

chown root.root /bin/busybox
chmod 4755 /bin/busybox

with all that done, telnetd _should_ work....

af8cfd5e8a5de6db17e8ddd4663de4c14bbd9dcd.english:
This option allows you to run telnetd in "inet wait" mode.
Example inetd.conf line (note "wait", not usual "nowait"):

telnet stream tcp wait root /bin/telnetd telnetd -w10

In this example, inetd passes _listening_ socket_ as fd 0
to telnetd when connection appears.
telnetd will wait for connections until all existing
connections are closed, and no new connections
appear during 10 seconds. Then it exits, and inetd continues
to listen for new connections.

This option is rarely used. "tcp nowait" is much more usual
way of running tcp services, including telnetd.
You most probably want to say N here.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许您以“ inet wait” 模式运行 telnetd 。

在此示例中, 插入通过   listening  socket  作为 fd 0
当连接出现时, 已调用。
telnetd 将等待连接, 直到所有已存在
连接已关闭, 没有新连接

以收听新连接。

On NOMMU machines, ssl_helper applet should be available
in the $PATH for this to work. Make sure to select that applet.

Note: currently, TLS code only makes TLS I/O work, it
does *not* check that the peer is who it claims to be, etc.
IOW: it uses peer-supplied public keys to establish encryption
and signing keys, then encrypts and signs outgoing data and
decrypts incoming data.
It does not check signature hashes on the incoming data:
this means that attackers manipulating TCP packets can
send altered data and we unknowingly receive garbage.
(This check might be relatively easy to add).
It does not check public key's certificate:
this means that the peer may be an attacker impersonating
the server we think we are talking to.

If you think this is unacceptable, consider this. As more and more
servers switch to HTTPS-only operation, without such "crippled"
TLS code it is *impossible* to simply download a kernel source
from kernel.org. Which can in real world translate into
"my small automatic tooling to build cross-compilers from sources
no longer works, I need to additionally keep a local copy
of ~4 megabyte source tarball of a SSL library and ~2 megabyte
source of wget, need to compile and built both before I can
download anything. All this despite the fact that the build
is done in a QEMU sandbox on a machine with absolutely nothing
worth stealing, so I don't care if someone would go to a lot
of trouble to intercept my HTTPS download to send me an altered
kernel tarball".

If you still think this is unacceptable, send patches.

If you still think this is unacceptable, do not want to send
patches, but do want to waste bandwidth expaining how wrong
it is, you will be ignored.

FEATURE_WGET_OPENSSL does implement TLS verification
using the certificates available to OpenSSL.

6e3ba74e01e229159ee87bb57f96999e2c19bc81.english: Try to connect to HTTPS using openssl

2781aa839d1b5ffff4979e2fda7ff8e965d98e52.english:
Try to use openssl to handle HTTPS.

OpenSSL has a simple SSL client for debug purposes.
If you select this option, wget will effectively run:
"openssl s_client -quiet -connect hostname:443
-servername hostname 2>/dev/null" and pipe its data
through it. -servername is not used if hostname is numeric.
Note inconvenient API: host resolution is done twice,
and there is no guarantee openssl's idea of IPv6 address
format is the same as ours.
Another problem is that s_client prints debug information
to stderr, and it needs to be suppressed. This means
all error messages get suppressed too.
openssl is also a big binary, often dynamically linked
against ~15 libraries.

If openssl can't be executed, internal TLS code will be used
(if you enabled it); if openssl can be executed but fails later,
wget can't detect this, and download will fail.

By default TLS verification is performed, unless
--no-check-certificate option is passed.

1ecb96264de33241199ebb8742b1836cefc412c8.english:
One common problem reported on the mailing list is the "can't
access tty; job control turned off" error message, which typically
appears when one tries to use a shell with stdin/stdout on
/dev/console.
This device is special - it cannot be a controlling tty.

The proper solution is to use the correct device instead of
/dev/console.

cttyhack provides a "quick and dirty" solution to this problem.
It analyzes stdin with various ioctls, trying to determine whether
it is a /dev/ttyN or /dev/ttySN (virtual terminal or serial line).
On Linux it also checks sysfs for a pointer to the active console.
If cttyhack is able to find the real console device, it closes
stdin/out/err and reopens that device.
Then it executes the given program. Opening the device will make
that device a controlling tty. This may require cttyhack
to be a session leader.

Example for /etc/inittab (for busybox init):

::respawn:/bin/cttyhack /bin/sh

Starting an interactive shell from boot shell script:

setsid cttyhack sh

Giving controlling tty to shell running with PID 1:

# exec cttyhack sh

Without cttyhack, you need to know exact tty name,
and do something like this:

# exec setsid sh -c 'exec sh </dev/tty1 >/dev/tty1 2>&1'

Starting getty on a controlling tty from a shell script:

# getty 115200 $(cttyhack)

translations.zh-CN:
邮件列表中报告的一个常见问题是"不能"
access tty; 任务控制关闭“ 错误消息, 通常是
当有人试图使用带有 stdin/ stdout 的外壳时, 会出现
/dev/console. (中文(简体) ).
此设备很特殊 - 它不能是控制 tty 。

正确的解决方法是使用正确的设备而不是
/dev/console. (中文(简体) ).

cttyhack为这个问题提供了"快速和肮脏"的解决方案.
它用各种辛醇/水分配系数分析Stdin,试图确定是否
它是/dev/ttyN或/dev/ttySN(虚拟终端或串行).
在Linux上,它也会检查sysfs对活动控制台的指针.
如果cttyhack能找到真正的控制台设备,它就会关闭
stdin/out/err 并重新打开该设备 。
然后它执行给定的程序. 打开设备将制作
那个装置是一个控制Tty。 这可能需要cttyhack
成为会议的领导者。

/etc/inittab(繁忙箱内)的例子:

* 复发:/bin/cttyhack/bin/sh

从启动 shell 脚本开始交互 shell :

(原始内容存档于2019-09-21). setsid cttyhack sh.

将控制 tty 赋予与 PID 1: 运行的 shell :

执行cttyhacksh

没有cttyhack, 你需要知道确切的tty名称,
做这样的事情:

# exec setsid sh - c 'exec sh </dev/tty1 >/dev/tty1 2\\1'

从 shell 脚本开始对控制 tty 开始 :

# Getty 115200美元(杂费)

and functions are supported.

It will compile and work on no-mmu systems.

It does not handle select, aliases, tilde expansion,
&>file and >&file redirection of stdout+stderr.

案例/摘要。 重新编号,这里的文件,$((数值))
和函数得到支持。

它将编译和研究无闪电系统。

它不处理选择的,别名, Tilde 扩展,
QQFile 和 QQFile 重定向 stdout+stderr 。

01754f435fa5eb45b6adcf6ef26f302160535758.english:
This option causes busybox shells to use busybox applets
in preference to executables in the PATH whenever possible. For
example, entering the command 'ifconfig' into the shell would cause
busybox to use the ifconfig busybox applet. Specifying the fully
qualified executable name, such as '/sbin/ifconfig' will still
execute the /sbin/ifconfig executable on the filesystem. This option
is generally used when creating a statically linked version of busybox
for use as a rescue shell, in the event that you screw up your system.

This is implemented by re-execing /proc/self/exe (typically)
with right parameters.

However, there are drawbacks: it is problematic in chroot jails
without mounted /proc, and ps/top may show command name as 'exe'
for applets started this way.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项会导致忙箱 shells 使用忙箱小程序
如果可能,则优先使用PATH中的可执行文件。 对于
例如,将命令“ 如果配置” 输入到 shell 会导致
使用 ifconfig 忙盒小程序。 完全指定
符合条件的可执行名称, 如“ / sbin/ ifconfig ” 仍然会
执行文件系统中的/sbin/ifconfig可执行文件。 此选项
一般在创建静态链接的忙框版本时使用
以防系统被破坏

执行方式是重新执行/程序/自我/实际(通常)
带有正确的参数。

然而,有缺点:在chroot监狱有问题。
不挂载/ proc, ps/ top 可能显示命令名为“ exe ”
对于小程序启动的方式。

c444ce18cef4c82012afa580dbee094ad1454281.english:
This option causes busybox shells to not execute typical
fork/exec/wait sequence, but call <applet>_main directly,
if possible. (Sometimes it is not possible: for example,
this is not possible in pipes).

This will be done only for some applets (those which are marked
NOFORK in include/applets.h).

This may significantly speed up some shell scripts.

This feature is relatively new. Use with care. Report bugs
to project mailing list.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项会导致 busybox shell 不执行典型
叉/ 执行/ 等待序列, 但直接调用 < applet%%% main,
如果可能的话。 (有时不可能:例如,
这在管道里是不可能的。

这将只为一些小程序( 标记为
(h) 列入/申请。

这可能会大大加速一些贝壳脚本.

这一特点相对较新. 使用时小心。 报告错误
到项目邮件列表。

35602ad0e78db96e4d535496ac3c50b502fd06e0.english: Enable support for fractional second timeout in read builtin.

translations.zh-CN: 在已读内存中启用分数第二次超时的支持 。

d23778e83cd40d2d8fa663ab89a88491cf59f05d.english:
This option makes busybox shells to use $HISTFILESIZE variable
to set shell history size. Note that its max value is capped
by "History size" setting in library tuning section.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项使忙箱 shell 使用 $HISTFILESIZE 变量
设置 shell 历史大小。 注意其最大值为上限
由库调制部分的"历史大小"设置.

f21d954a9ef42b9e07680baf1a598e1985c226d0.english:
Allow scripts to be compressed and embedded in the busybox
binary. The scripts should be placed in the 'embed' directory
at build time. Like applets, scripts can be run as
'busybox SCRIPT ...' or by linking their name to the binary.

This also allows applets to be implemented as scripts: place
the script in 'applets_sh' and a stub C file containing
configuration in the appropriate subsystem directory.

translations.zh-CN:
允许将脚本压缩并嵌入繁忙框
二进制. 脚本应放在 'embed' 目录中
在建设时间。 像小程序一样,脚本可以运行为
'busybox SCRIPT...' 或通过将其名称与二进制连接.

这也允许小程序作为脚本执行: 位置
在“ applets  sh” 中的脚本和包含
在适当的子系统目录中配置。

016e2528e27ac69ec75ee07cf7fc05d3dfaafb4a.english:
klogd is a utility which intercepts and logs all
messages from the Linux kernel and sends the messages
out to the 'syslogd' utility so they can be logged. If
you wish to record the messages produced by the kernel,
you should enable this option.

translations.zh-CN:
klogd 是拦截和记录全部工具
从 Linux 内核发送信件
打开“ syslogd” 工具, 以便记录它们 。 若为
您想要记录内核生成的信息,
您应该启用此选项。

e1ff9605fa6e43fe5b1c9055d23a73bfd3799aa7.english:
The klogd applet supports two interfaces for reading
kernel messages. Linux provides the klogctl() interface
which allows reading messages from the kernel ring buffer
independently from the file system.

If you answer 'N' here, klogd will use the more portable
approach of reading them from /proc or a device node.
However, this method requires the file to be available.

If in doubt, say 'Y'.

translations.zh-CN:
klogd 小程序支持两个界面的读取
内核消息. Linux 提供了 klogctl () 接口
允许从内核环缓冲器读取信件
独立于文件系统。

如果你在这里回答“ N ” , klogd 会使用更便携的
从/proc或设备节点读取它们的方法。
然而,这种方法要求文件是可用的.

如果有疑问,说"Y"。

7b9fcea779931adbf371e8d0748b43ff44554755.english:
The logger utility allows you to send arbitrary text
messages to the system log (i.e. the 'syslogd' utility) so
they can be logged. This is generally used to help locate
problems that occur within programs and scripts.

translations.zh-CN:
日志工具允许您发送任意文本
给系统日志的信件( 即“ syslogd” 工具) 所以
他们可以被记录。 一般用于帮助查找
程序和脚本中发生的问题。

c4ebbb001a04e94ae0ffcf127fb7b04db30fc220.english:
If you enabled Circular Buffer support, you almost
certainly want to enable this feature as well. This
utility will allow you to read the messages that are
stored in the syslogd circular buffer.

translations.zh-CN:
如果您启用循环缓冲支持,则几乎
当然也想启用这个功能。 这个
工具将允许您读取信件
存储在 syslogd 循环缓冲器中。

c3b2f0552da032c4c9b9ba5197b8c189222f806b.english:
'logread' output to slow serial terminals can have
side effects on syslog because of the semaphore.
This option make logread to double buffer copy
from circular buffer, minimizing semaphore
contention at some minor memory expense.

translations.zh-CN:
慢序终端的“ logread” 输出
副作用于syslog 因为semaphore。
此选项将日志读取为双倍缓冲复制
从循环缓冲,最小化semapore
争论费少一些记忆费。

94c069cf2a4f482db732000134993445f3b220c2.english:
The syslogd utility is used to record logs of all the
significant events that occur on a system. Every
message that is logged records the date and time of the
event, and will generally also record the name of the
application that generated the message. When used in
conjunction with klogd, messages from the Linux kernel
can also be recorded. This is terribly useful,
especially for finding what happened when something goes
wrong. And something almost always will go wrong if
you wait long enough....

translations.zh-CN:
Syslogd 工具用于记录全部日志
系统上发生的重大事件。 每个
记录日期和时间
事件,一般也会记录
生成消息的应用程序。 用于
与 klogd 连接, 来自 Linux 内核 的信息
也可以录制. 这是非常有用的,
特别是当事情发生时
错了 如果... 事情总是会出错的
你等得够久了...

c20382276315166fb64ac5e58f00b1ba8e28a7e8.english:
This enables syslogd to rotate the message files
on his own. No need to use an external rotate script.

translations.zh-CN:
这使得 syslogd 可以旋转信件文件
独自一人 不需要使用外部旋转脚本 。

77000aed4bfa44a22d7d9e1c03353fb8d8a153c4.english:
When you enable this feature, the syslogd utility can
be used to send system log messages to another system
connected via a network. This allows the remote
machine to log all the system messages, which can be
terribly useful for reducing the number of serial
cables you use. It can also be a very good security
measure to prevent system logs from being tampered with
by an intruder.

translations.zh-CN:
当您启用此功能时, syslogd 工具可以
用于向另一个系统发送系统日志消息
通过网络连接。 这允许远程
记录所有系统消息的机器,可以是
在减少序列数方面非常有用
你使用的电缆。 它也可以是一个非常好的安全
防止系统日志被篡改的措施
一个入侵者。

d1d7aebe6fcef0ad078da8756e8250ef257b5ded.english:
Option -D instructs syslogd to drop consecutive messages
which are totally the same.

translations.zh-CN:
选项 - D 指示 syslogd 发送连续信件
这些都是完全相同的。

a25c436e0fea483409710149c3def905abd1972c.english: Supports restricted syslogd config. See docs/syslog.conf.txt

translations.zh-CN: 支持限制性的 syslogd 配置 。 见docs/syslog.conf.txt

229988eca07aecbf2f667391e160aca03fb09bd5.english:
Includes milliseconds (HH:MM:SS.mmm) in timestamp when

translations.zh-CN:
包括时标的毫秒(HH:MM:SS.mmm)
添加时间戳。

7f847202bf2841fbca5bf087f8a349c9f441664e.english:
This option sets the size of the syslog read buffer.
Actual memory usage increases around five times the
change done here.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项设置 syslog 读取缓冲器的大小 。
实际内存使用增加5倍左右
在这里做了更改。

a2b0ea82857dc1757cf16fc42dbc76e4d855280f.english:
When you enable this feature, the syslogd utility will
use a circular buffer to record system log messages.
When the buffer is filled it will continue to overwrite
the oldest messages. This can be very useful for
systems with little or no permanent storage, since
otherwise system logs can eventually fill up your
entire filesystem, which may cause your system to
break badly.

translations.zh-CN:
当启用此特性时, syslogd 工具将
使用循环缓冲来记录系统日志消息.
当缓冲器被填充后,它将继续覆盖
最古老的信息。 这对
很少或没有永久储存的系统,自
否则系统日志最终会填充您的
整个文件系统,可能导致您的系统
打破严重。

69b0c71ec5e016ffd9bd28181c8fc83ff9ac9255.english:
This option sets the size of the circular buffer
used to record system log messages.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项设置循环缓冲器的大小
用于记录系统日志消息。

936ed36c2ced09cdc8064eb437ed1f5cd8db0c9c.english:
When you enable this feature, the syslogd utility will
write system log message to the Linux kernel's printk buffer.
This can be used as a smaller alternative to the syslogd IPC
support, as klogd and logread aren't needed.

NOTICE: Syslog facilities in log entries needs kernel 3.5+.

translations.zh-CN:
当启用此特性时, syslogd 工具将
将系统日志消息写入 Linux 内核的 printk 缓冲器 。
这可以用作syslogd IPC的较小的替代品
支持,因为不需要klogd和logread.

日志条目中的Syslog设施需要内核3.5+.

b754d7b83131a6a33b744d3bfbcce1c449248aea.english: The SELinux Reference Policy project (refpolicy) is a complete SELinux policy that can be used as the system policy for a variety of systems and used as the basis for creating other policies. Reference Policy was originally based on the NSA example policy, but aims to accomplish many additional goals. The current refpolicy does not fully support OpenWRT and needs modifications to work with the default system file layout. These changes should be added as patches to the refpolicy that modify a single SELinux policy. The refpolicy works for the most part in permissive mode. Only the basic set of utilities are enabled in the example policy config and some of the pathing in the policies is not correct.  Individual policies would need to be tweaked to get everything functioning properly. http://selinuxproject.org/page/Main_Page Thomas Petazzoni <thomas.petazzoni@bootlin.com>

translations.zh-CN: SELinux参考政策项目(refpolicy)是一个完整的SELinux政策,可以作为多种系统的系统政策,并作为创建其他政策的基础. 参考政策最初基于消极安全保证的范例政策,但旨在实现许多额外目标。 当前refpolicy不完全支持OpenWRT,需要修改才能与默认系统文件布局配合. 这些修改应作为修改单一SELinux政策的Refpolicy的补丁加入. 调整政策在多数情况下是允许的。 实例政策配置中只允许使用一套基本公用事业,政策中的一些路径也不正确。 需要调整个别政策,使一切正常运转。 http://selinuxproject.org/page/Main_Page 托马斯·佩塔佐尼 <Thomas.petazzoni@bootlin.com>

663918344242cd9941445f97d58645470336ac19.english: urngd is OpenWrt's micro non-physical true random number generator based on timing jitter. Using the Jitter RNG core, the rngd provides an entropy source that feeds into the Linux /dev/random device if its entropy runs low. It updates the /dev/random entropy estimator such that the newly provided entropy unblocks /dev/random. The seeding of /dev/random also ensures that /dev/urandom benefits from entropy. Especially during boot time, when the entropy of Linux is low, the Jitter RNGd provides a source of sufficient entropy.

translations.zh-CN: urngd是OpenWrt的微非物理真实随机数生成器,基于计时时热. 使用Jitter RNG核心,rngd提供了一个 en源,如果它的 en运行低,它会向Linux /dev/random设备进食. 它更新了 /dev/random entropy 估计器,这样新提供的entropy unblocks /dev/random就可以了. /dev/random的播种也确保了/dev/urandom受益于 en. 特别是在靴子时间,当Linux的 en值较低时,Jitter RNGd提供了足够 en值的来源.

508c5aa206dbad1dd4f93c0213156b2b642b9dee.english: Atop is an ASCII full-screen performance monitor for Linux that is capable of reporting the activity of all processes (even if processes have finished during the interval), daily logging of system and process activity for long-term analysis, highlighting overloaded system resources by using colors, etcetera. At regular intervals, it shows system-level activity related to the CPU, memory, swap, disks (including LVM) and network layers, and for every process (and thread) it shows e.g. the CPU utilization, memory growth, disk utilization, priority, username, state, and exit code. In combination with the optional kernel module netatop, it even shows network activity per process/thread. https://www.atoptool.nl/ Toni Uhlig <matzeton@googlemail.com>

716cf4e5041f933ee0476c6c7c39a12f292741eb.english: Netfilter (IPv4/IPv6) module for matching cluster This option allows you to build work-load-sharing clusters of network servers/stateful firewalls without having a dedicated load-balancing router/server/switch. Basically, this match returns true when the packet must be handled by this cluster node. Thus, all nodes see all packets and this match decides which node handles what packets. The work-load sharing algorithm is based on source address hashing. This module is usable for ipv4 and ipv6. To use it also enable iptables-mod-cluster see `iptables -m cluster --help` for more information.

translations.zh-CN: 匹配集群的Netfilter( IPv4/ IPv6) 模块 此选项允许您在不设专用负载平衡路由器/ 服务器/ 交换器的情况下, 构建网络服务器/ 状态防火墙的工作负荷共享集群 。 基本上, 当数据包必须由这个集群节点处理时, 此匹配返回为真 。 因此,所有节点都能看到所有的数据包,这个匹配决定哪个节点处理哪个数据包. 工作负荷共享算法基于源地址散列. 此模块可用于 ipv4 和 ipv6. 要使用它,还可以使用 iptables-mod-cluster 见`iptables -m cluster --help` 获取更多信息.

6437a7765b74f02927ff81f3e192ed3842895f8e.english: The optional kernel module netatop can be loaded to gather statistics about the TCP and UDP packets that have been transmitted/received per process and per thread. As soon as atop discovers that this module is active, it shows the columns SNET and RNET in the generic screen for the number of transmitted and received packets per process. When the 'n' key is pressed, it shows detailed counters about the number packets transmitted/received via TCP and UDP, the average sizes of these packets, and the total bandwidth consumed for input and output per process/thread. https://www.atoptool.nl/ Toni Uhlig <matzeton@googlemail.com>

translations.zh-CN: 可选的内核模块netatop可以被加载,以收集每个进程和每个线程已经传输/接收的TCP和UDP包的统计数据. 一旦 Atop 发现此模块已激活,它就会在通用屏幕中显示每个进程传输和接收数据包的列 SNET 和 RNET 。 在按下'n'键时,它会显示详细的计数器,说明通过TCP和UDP传输/接收的数字包,这些数据包的平均大小,以及每个过程/线程输入和输出所消耗的总带宽. https://www.atoptool.nl/ Toni Uhlig <matzeton@googlemail.com> (中文(简体) ).

e23176bbc44e3f220bf8f7834c85b8cc8618d617.english:
This option enables the B.A.T.M.A.N. V protocol, the successor
of the currently used B.A.T.M.A.N. IV protocol. The main
changes include splitting of the OGM protocol into a neighbor
discovery protocol (Echo Location Protocol, ELP) and a new OGM
Protocol OGMv2 for flooding protocol information through the
network, as well as a throughput based metric.
B.A.T.M.A.N. V is currently considered experimental and not
compatible to B.A.T.M.A.N. IV networks.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可实现B.A.T.M.A.N.V.协议,后续协议
目前使用的B.A.T.M.A.N.IV.协议。 主语
更改包括 OGM 协议拆分为邻
发现协议(Echo Location Protocol,ELP)和一个新的OGM
《关于通过
网络,以及基于吞吐量的衡量标准。
B.A.T.M.A.N.V.目前被认为是实验性的,而不是
兼容B.A.T.M.A.N.IV网络。

7b59c1d40b50f90d9253ffca8e5b93b9a1b332c4.english:
This option enables BLA (Bridge Loop Avoidance), a mechanism
to avoid Ethernet frames looping when mesh nodes are connected
to both the same LAN and the same mesh. If you will never use
more than one mesh node in the same LAN, you can safely remove
this feature and save some space.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许 BLA( Bridge 循环避免), 一种机制
以避免网格节点连接时以太网框架循环
同一局域网和网格 如果你永远不会使用
在同一局域网中一个以上的网点,可以安全取出
此特性并保存一些空间。

8a569718b0c37c632a7502bee447211cb0ab988b.english:
This option enables DAT (Distributed ARP Table), a DHT based
mechanism that increases ARP reliability on sparse wireless
mesh networks. If you think that your network does not need
this option you can safely remove it and save some space.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许基于 DHT 的 DAT( 分布式 ARP 表)

5c80bd8db3c68889ab19e4314568cc43b323c209.english: Enable full debugging output in the iwlwifi driver

2f69bd918a656b2005b08c5563afc9589354b39c.english:
This option will enable debug tracing output for the iwlwifi drivers

This will result in the kernel module being ~100k larger.  You can
control which debug output is sent to the kernel log by setting the
value in

/sys/module/iwlwifi/parameters/debug

This entry will only exist if this option is enabled.

To set a value, simply echo an 8-byte hex value to the same file:

% echo 0x43fff > /sys/module/iwlwifi/parameters/debug

You can find the list of debug mask values in:
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/iwl-debug.h

If this is your first time using this driver, you should say Y here
as the debug information can assist others in helping you resolve
any problems you may encounter.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项将启用 iwlwifi 驱动程序调试跟踪输出

这将导致内核模块的大小为~100k. 你们可以
通过设置调试输出到内核日志的控制
数值在

/sys/module/iwlwifi/参数/调试

此条目只有在启用此选项时才会存在 。

要设置值, 只需对同一文件的 8 字节六进制值进行回声 :

%回声 0x43fff > /sys/module/iwlwifi/参数/调试

您可以在 :
驱动/网/无线/英特尔/iwlwifi/iwl-debug.h

如果这是你第一次使用这个司机, 你应该说Y在这里
由于调试信息可以帮助其他人帮助您解决
遇到任何问题

edf63cf89e7fe635c4d9ae3cd067f16bafb991cc.english: This is an alternative driver for various Realtek RTL8XXX parts written to utilize the Linux mac80211 stack. The driver is known to work with a number of RTL8723AU, RL8188CU, RTL8188RU, RTL8191CU, and RTL8192CU devices This driver is under development and has a limited feature set. In particular it does not yet support 40MHz channels and power management. However it should have a smaller memory footprint than the vendor drivers and benetifs from the in kernel mac80211 stack. It can coexist with drivers from drivers/staging/rtl8723au, drivers/staging/rtl8192u, and drivers/net/wireless/rtlwifi, but you will need to control which module you wish to load. RTL8XXXU_UNTESTED is enabled This option enables detection of Realtek 8723/8188/8191/8192 WiFi USB devices which have not been tested directly by the driver author or reported to be working by third parties. Please report your results! https://wireless.wiki.kernel.org/ Felix Fietkau <nbd@nbd.name>

b1a772b927c490a603b6d8de881716e0d2256da3.english: libselinux is the runtime SELinux library that provides interfaces (e.g. library functions for the SELinux kernel APIs like getcon(), other support functions like getseuserbyname()) to SELinux-aware applications. libselinux may use the shared libsepol to manipulate the binary policy if necessary (e.g. to downgrade the policy format to an older version supported by the kernel) when loading policy. This package provides the Python bindings for libselinux. http://selinuxproject.org/page/Main_Page Thomas Petazzoni <thomas.petazzoni@bootlin.com>

translations.zh-CN: libselinux是运行时间 SELinux 库,为 SELinux 内核API 提供接口(如 selinux 内核函数如 feecon (),其他支持功能如 geeuserbyname ()) 到 SELinux-aware 应用程序. libselinux在装入策略时,可能在必要时使用共享的libsepol来操纵二进制策略(例如将策略格式降级为由内核支持的更老版本). 这个软件包为libselinux提供了Python绑定. http://selinuxproject.org/page/Main_Page 托马斯·佩塔佐尼 <Thomas.petazzoni@bootlin.com>

b3d841412c226a88bc9e31ce9f08446d3f676b28.english: libsemanage is the policy management library. It uses libsepol for binary policy manipulation and libselinux for interacting with the SELinux system. It also exec's helper programs for loading policy and for checking whether the file_contexts configuration is valid (load_policy and setfiles from policycoreutils) presently, although this may change at least for the bootstrapping case (for rpm). This package provides the Python bindings for libsemanage. http://selinuxproject.org/page/Main_Page Thomas Petazzoni <thomas.petazzoni@bootlin.com>

translations.zh-CN: libsemanage是政策管理图书馆. 它使用libsepol进行二进制政策操纵并使用libselinux与SELinux系统进行互动. 它还执行用于加载策略的帮助程序,并用于检查文件 texts配置是否有效(load policy and setfiles from politiclecentutils),尽管这至少会改变(用于 rpm) 拖曳的大小写. 此套件为libsemanage提供了Python绑定. http://selinuxproject.org/page/Main_Page 托马斯·佩塔佐尼 <Thomas.petazzoni@bootlin.com>

c7fa0e42e28a4b9a0e31b007a9125af61a300dbb.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS library. https://github.com/owfs/owfs Jo-Philipp Wich <jo@mein.io>

translations.zh-CN: OWFS是一套旨在使一线总线及其装置易于取用的程序. 其根本原则是创建虚拟文件系统,以独有的ID为目录,设备的单个属性被作为简单的文件来表示,可以读取并写出. 单个奴隶或主设计的细节被隐藏在一个一致的界面后. 目标是为软件设计师创建监测或控制应用程序提供一套简单的工具. 实施中有一些性能增强,包括数据缓存,平行访问总线主机,以及设备通信的汇总. 资金的目标仍然是便于使用、灵活和正确,而不是速度。 此包包含 OWFS 库 。 https://github.com/owfs/owfs 乔-菲利普·维克 <jo@mein.io>

27b539c3743b9f322b78c2a1f911d944ca863a76.english: Fwknop implements an authorization scheme known as Single Packet Authorization (SPA) for Linux systems running iptables.  This mechanism requires only a single encrypted and non-replayed packet to communicate various pieces of information including desired access through an iptables policy. The main application of this program is to use iptables in a default-drop stance to protect services such as SSH with an additional layer of security in order to make the exploitation of vulnerabilities (both 0-day and unpatched code) much more difficult. This package contains the libfko shared library. https://www.cipherdyne.org/fwknop/ Jonathan Bennett <JBennett@incomsystems.biz>

translations.zh-CN: Fwknop针对运行iptables的Linux系统执行名为"单包授权"(SPA)的授权方案. 这种机制只需要一个加密的、非重放的包就可以传递各种信息,包括通过iptables政策进行预期访问。 这个程序的主要应用是使用iptables在默认投放姿势中保护像SSH这样的具有多一层安全功能的服务,以便让利用弱点(包括0天和无标码)更加困难. 此套件包含 libfko 共享库 。 (原始内容存档于2018-09-26) (英语). https://www.cipherdyne.org/fwknop/ 乔纳森·贝内特 <J Bennett@incomsystems.biz>

c393fdfc67db8bae5aa1b93a2c89fbe8cf02ad96.english:
Use of the ARMv8 Crypto Extensions greatly increase performance
(up to 4x faster on AES-GCM while 10x faster on raw AES).

If you don't sure, say Y here.

translations.zh-CN:
使用 ARMv8 加密扩展会大大提高性能
(在AES-GCM上速度可达4x快而生AES上速度可达10x快).

如果你不确定,就说Y在这里。

8c1adb9dd5a094e63d7c9ddd3074007efce8773f.english: Enable use of x86 SSE2 instructions

7f9fde194a87da0f2e0445c43baa24b06c86a578.english:
Use of SSE2 instructions greatly increase performance (up to
3x faster) with a minimum (~0.2%, or 23KB) increase in package
size, but it will bring no benefit if your hardware does not
support them, such as Geode GX and LX.  In this case you may
save 23KB by saying yes here.  AMD Geode NX, and Intel
Pentium 4 and above support SSE2.

translations.zh-CN:
SSE2指令的使用大大提高了性能(最多
3x快),包件最小增加(~0.2%,或23KB)
大小, 但是如果硬件不起作用, 将无益
支持它们,例如Geode GX和LX. 在这种情况下,你可以
23KB在这里表示是。 AMD Geode NX和英特尔
Pentium 4及以上支持SSE2.

cee35ad9b576a1a53cde83d26efd7a9f9c374fa9.english:
Enabling this option increases code size (around 20%) and
performance.  The increase in performance and size depends on the
target CPU. EC and AES seem to benefit the most, with EC speed
increased by 20%-50% (mipsel & x86).
AES-GCM is supposed to be 3x faster on x86. YMMV.

表现。 业绩和规模的增加取决于
目标CPU. 欧共体和AES似乎受益最大,而且速度快
增长了20%-50%(mipsel & x86)。
AES-GCM在x86上应该是3x快. YMMV(英语:YMMV).

mipsel      1.5K   BN+97%, aes+4%, sha1+94%, sha256+60%
mips64	    3.7K   BN, aes, sha1, sha256, sha512, poly1305
powerpc    20K     BN, aes, sha1, sha256, sha512, poly1305
x86_64    228K     BN+220%, aes+173%, rc4+38%, sha1+40%, sha256+64%, sha512+31%, nist256+354%, poly1305+228%

* Only most common algorithms shown. Your mileage may vary.
BN (bignum) performance was measured using RSA sign/verify.

mipsel 1.5K BN+97%,aes+4%,sha1+94%,sha256+60%

20K BN、aes、sha1、sha256、sha512、多聚1305

* 只有最常用的算法显示。 你的里程可能会不同

It aims:
* to increase the overall security of the protocol,

when performing a full handshake.

translations.zh-CN:
TLS 1.3是TLS规格的最新版本.
其目标是:
* 加强议定书的总体安全,
删除已过时的算法,并加密更多
协议;
* 通过减少往返次数来提高业绩
完全握手时
它能使包大小增加~4KB.

0f15a0e51460eebc33c6171e56bfa36af5e97b04.english:
Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) provides TLS-like security
for datagram-based (UDP, DCCP, CAPWAP, SCTP & SRTP) applications.

translations.zh-CN:
Datagram 传输层安全( DTLS) 提供类似 TLS 的安全
用于基于数据的应用(UDP、DCCP、CAPWAP、SCTP和SRTP)。

c4155caf94ff404b7a1ffc6ae87182b875567799.english:
NPN is a TLS extension, obsoleted and replaced with ALPN,
used to negotiate SPDY, and HTTP/2.

translations.zh-CN:
NPN是一个TLS扩展,已过时并被ALPN所取代,
曾谈判SPDY,和HTTP/2.

bc0a34fbebc9a6daa7e378162f8cbb79460cab9d.english:
The Secure Remote Password protocol (SRP) is an augmented
password-authenticated key agreement (PAKE) protocol, specifically
designed to work around existing patents.

translations.zh-CN:

密码认证密钥协议(PAKE)协议,特别是
旨在围绕现有专利开展工作。

ef1c6403e0a4b2e45e98492f5f2c629d02e1c2c9.english:
ChaCha20-Poly1305 is an AEAD ciphersuite with 256-bit keys,
combining ChaCha stream cipher with Poly1305 MAC.
It is 3x faster than AES, when not using a CPU with AES-specific
instructions, as is the case of most embedded devices.

translations.zh-CN:
ChaCha20-Poly1305是一个AEAD密码套件,有256位键,
将ChaCha流密码与Poly1305 MAC结合.
它比AES快3x, 当不使用带有AES特异性的CPU时
指令,如大多数嵌入式设备。

db8eb85b85b8750767f551408eb6ad2541ae2a4b.english: Prefer ChaCha20-Poly1305 over AES-GCM by default

0400dfcd79c98e16210084805e8d0c36470124d5.english:
The default openssl preference is for AES-GCM before ChaCha, but
that takes into account AES-NI capable chips.  It is not the
case with most embedded chips, so it may be better to invert
that preference.  This is just for the default case. The
application can always override this.

translations.zh-CN:
默认打开的首选是 ChaCha 之前的 AES- GCM, 但是
考虑AES-NI能力芯片。 不是那个
包含大多数嵌入式芯片的大小写, 因此倒置可能更好
那个偏好。 这只是为了默认案件。 这个
应用程序总是可以覆盖它。

b57e4130b6cc57b4a317976bc6d876341be9db55.english:
RFC 3779 defines two X.509 v3 certificate extensions.  The first
binds a list of IP address blocks, or prefixes, to the subject of a
certificate.  The second binds a list of autonomous system
identifiers to the subject of a certificate.  These extensions may be
used to convey the authorization of the subject to use the IP
addresses and autonomous system identifiers contained in the
extensions.

translations.zh-CN:

将 IP 地址块列表或前缀绑定在 a 的主题上
证书。 第二种是自动系统列表
证书对象的标识符。 这些扩展可以是:
用于传递主体使用IP的授权
地址和自动系统标识符
扩展。

39bce25358f36af497dd5c0667fbafda31905103.english:
This enables alternative cryptography implementations,
most commonly for interfacing with external crypto devices,
or supporting new/alternative ciphers and digests.
If you compile the library with this option disabled, packages built
using an engine-enabled library (i.e. from the official repo) may
fail to run.  Compile and install the packages with engine support
disabled, and you should be fine.
Note that you need to enable KERNEL_AIO to be able to build the
afalg engine package.

这使得其他加密执行成为可能,
通常用于与外部加密设备的接口,
或支持新的/替代的密码和文摘。
如果您使用此选项编译库, 将构建软件包
使用引擎辅助库(即来自官方回购)

a00ba11a5af1d9ba244ebc72626487237fcb15be.english:
Digests are fast in software, and accessing AF_ALG adds latency, so
you'll need a large request (16KB) just to match software speed.
This increases memory usage, and has problems when process fork
with open digest contexts (openssh will not work because of it).

translations.zh-CN:
文摘在软件上速度快,访问AF ALG会增加延迟,所以
您需要一个大请求( 16KB) 来匹配软件速度。
这将增加内存的使用, 并在进程叉时有问题
有开放的文摘背景( Opensh 将因它而失效).

832d777e48f8833adcd8c5a554ffdc0c6701d44d.english:
Use software to fulfill small requests.  Using AF_ALG adds latency,
which makes it slow to perform small requests.  Enabling this
option overcomes this problem, at the cost of increased memory
and CPU usage.  This is a new, experimental feature; if you
encounter any problem, this is the first option to disable.
The fallback will fail if you enable this engine alongside
devcrypto, so you'll not be able to install both at the same
time if this option is enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
使用软件满足小请求. 使用 AF ALG 添加耐性,
这使得执行小请求的速度缓慢. 启用此功能
以增加内存为代价克服这一问题
和CPU的使用. 这是一个新的实验性特征,如果你
遇到任何问题, 这是第一个禁用选项 。
如果您同时启用此引擎, 后退将会失败 。
{\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}这样你就不能同时安装
如果启用此选项, 则需要时间 。

fdb09ebd35eef5321297ac650b3b0187458d1740.english: Don't rely on kernel to update CTR IV

d27704ef13075d30ec7a33f5e6abbfa55716b325.english:
Don't count on the kernel driver to update the CTR-mode counter
(IV).  At least one driver does not update the IV as a workaround
for DMA issues.  With this option turned on, the engine will keep
track of the counter, and the IV will be sent with every update.
If fallback is enabled, then the counter needs to be updated by
the engine anyway, and sent with the request everytime there's a
switch from software to hardware, so this won't bring much gain in
that case.

translations.zh-CN:
不要靠内核驱动程序更新 CTR 模式计数器
页:1 至少有一个驱动程序不更新 IV 是一个工作轮
就DMA问题而言 此选项启用后, 引擎将保留
计数器的音轨,四号将随每次更新一起被发送.
如果启用倒计时器, 则需要通过
无论如何,引擎,并随请求发送 每次有一个
从软件切换到硬件,这样不会带来什么好处
那个案子

4bfa9d95ad55c5e0e6de27607c96a60edee33475.english: Avahi is an mDNS/DNS-SD (aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf) implementation (library). It facilitates service discovery on a local network -- this means that you can plug your laptop or computer into a network and instantly be able to view other people who you can chat with, find printers to print to or find files being shared. This kind of technology is already found in MacOS X (branded 'Rendezvous', 'Bonjour' and sometimes 'ZeroConf') and is very convenient. . This packages adds the libavahi-client library. It also automatically adds the required libavahi-dbus-support and the avahi-dbus-daemon packages. For more information please see the avahi documentation. http://www.avahi.org/ Ted Hess <thess@kitschensync.net>

translations.zh-CN: Avahi是一个mDNS/DNS-SD(aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf)执行(图书馆). 它为本地网络上的服务发现提供了便利——这意味着你可以将你的笔记本电脑或计算机插入网络,并立即能够查看其他人,你可以和他们聊天,找到打印机打印到或找到正在共享的文件. 这种技术已经在MacOS X(被命名为"Rendezvous","Bonjour",有时为"ZeroConf")中被找到,并且非常方便. . 此套件添加了 libavahi 客户端库 。 它还会自动添加所需的libavahi-dbus-支持和avahi-dbus-daemon套件. 详情请见Avahi文件。 (原始内容存档于2018-09-29) (英语). http://www.avahi.org/ Ted Hess <thes@kitschensync.net>

8b1cbbd21a35f9c081159b6ebf0042f3bce49bf1.english: Avahi is an mDNS/DNS-SD (aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf) implementation (library). It facilitates service discovery on a local network -- this means that you can plug your laptop or computer into a network and instantly be able to view other people who you can chat with, find printers to print to or find files being shared. This kind of technology is already found in MacOS X (branded 'Rendezvous', 'Bonjour' and sometimes 'ZeroConf') and is very convenient. . The libavahi package contains the mDNS/DNS-SD shared libraries, used by other programs. Specifically, it provides libavahi-core and libavahi-common libraries. . The libavahi-dbus-support package enables D-Bus support in avahi, needed to support the libavahi-client library and avahi-utils. . Selecting this package modifies the build configuration so that avahi packages are built with support for D-BUS enabled; it does not generate a separate binary of its own. It also automatically adds the D-Bus package to the build. libavahi-dbus-support is selected automatically if you select libavahi-client or avahi-utils. http://www.avahi.org/ Ted Hess <thess@kitschensync.net>

Enable HTTP over unix domain sockets.
To use this with the curl command line, you specify the socket path to the new --unix-domain option.

8522c596ecf166f519c34230b34f6d77efae8fe3.english: libdaemon is a lightweight C library that eases the writing of UNIX daemons. It consists of the following parts: - A wrapper around fork() which does the correct daemonization procedure of a process - A wrapper around syslog() for simpler and compatible log output to Syslog or STDERR - An API for writing PID files - An API for serializing UNIX signals into a pipe for usage with select() or poll() - An API for running subprocesses with STDOUT and STDERR redirected to syslog APIs like these are used in most daemon software available. It is not that simple to get it done right and code duplication is not a goal. http://0pointer.de/lennart/projects/libdaemon/ Ted Hess <thess@kitschensync.net>

translations.zh-CN: libdaemon是一个轻量级的 C 库,可以轻松地写出 UNIX 守护进程. 它由以下部分组成: - 一个绕叉()的包装器,它执行一个进程的正确守护进程 - 一个绕syslog()的包装器,用于向Syslog或STDERR提供更简单和相容的日志输出 - 一个API,用于写入PID文件 - 一个API,用于将UNIX信号序列化为一个管道,用于选择()或民意测验() - 一个API,用于运行带有STDUT和STDERR的子进程,这种Syslog API被重定向到大多数可用的守护进程软件中. 要做到正确不是那么简单,重复代码不是一个目标。 (原始内容存档于2018-09-29) (英语). http://0pointer.de/lennart/projects/libdaemon/ Ted Hess <thes@kitschensync.net>

e154cb9d49ecbbad75e164be5f43b29e36283bed.english: The libevent API provides a mechanism to execute a callback function when a specific event occurs on a file descriptor or after a timeout has been reached. Furthermore, libevent also support callbacks due to signals or regular timeouts. libevent is meant to replace the event loop found in event driven network servers. An application just needs to call event_dispatch() and then add or remove events dynamically without having to change the event loop. This package contains the libevent shared library historically containing both the core & extra libraries. http://libevent.org Jo-Philipp Wich <jo@mein.io>

f176dda1889dfbd700ea1bc71b3c1cbed4f3b55d.english: The libffi library provides a portable, high level programming interface to various calling conventions. This allows a programmer to call any function specified by a call interface description at run-time. FFI stands for Foreign Function Interface. A foreign function interface is the popular name for the interface that allows code written in one language to call code written in another language. The libffi library really only provides the lowest, machine dependent layer of a fully featured foreign function interface. A layer must exist above libffi that handles type conversions for values passed between the two languages. http://sourceware.org/libffi/ Peter Wagner <tripolar@gmx.at>

translations.zh-CN: libffi图书馆为各种调用会提供可移植的高水平编程接口. 这允许程序员在运行时调用调用接口描述所指定的任何函数. FFI代表外国函数界面. 一个外语函数接口是接口的通称,它允许用一种语言所写的代码调用用另一种语言所写的代码. libffi库实际上只提供一个功能齐全的外文功能界面中最低的,机器依赖层. libffi上方必须有一个图层,用于处理两种语言之间传递的值的类型转换。 http://sourceware.org/libffi/ 彼得·瓦格纳 < 三极地@gmx.at>

be90ecb5c35037d69f2d936658a450121f228863.english: This is a general purpose cryptographic library based on the code from GnuPG. It provides functions for all cryptograhic building blocks: symmetric ciphers (AES, DES, Arcfour, CAST5), hash algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, RIPE-MD160, SHA-224/256, SHA-384/512), MACs (HMAC for all hash algorithms), public key algorithms (RSA, DSA), large integer functions, random numbers and a lot of supporting functions. Some algorithms have been disabled to reduce size (Blowfish, Twofish, Serpent, RC2, SEED, Camellia, CRC, MD4, TIGER-192, Whirlpool, ElGamal, ECC). https://www.gnupg.org/related_software/libgcrypt/ W. Michael Petullo <mike@flyn.org>

translations.zh-CN: 这是一个通用密码库,基于GnuPG的代码. 它为所有密码学的构件提供功能:对称密码(AES,DES,Arcfour,CAST5),散列算法(MD5,SHA-1,RIPE-MD160,SHA-224/256,SHA-384/512),MAC(HMAC适用于所有散列算法),公钥算法(RSA,DSA),大整数函数,随机数和许多辅助函数. 一些算法被禁用来缩小尺寸(Blowfish, Twofish, Serpent, RC2, SEED, Camellia, CRC, MD4, TIGER-192, Whirlpool, ElGamal, ECC). https://www.gnupg.org/related_software/libgcrypt/ W. 迈克尔·佩图洛 <mike@flyn.org>

b59568421e6bcef037f62888c0fbb556c690a0e6.english: gpsd is a userland daemon acting as a translator between GPS and AIS receivers and their clients. gpsd listens on port 2947 for clients requesting position/time/velocity information.  The receivers are expected to generate position information in a well-known format -- as NMEA-0183 sentences, SiRF binary, Rockwell binary, Garmin binary format, or other vendor binary protocols.  gpsd takes this information from the GPS and translates it into something uniform and easier to understand for clients. This package contains the libgps library. https://gpsd.gitlab.io/gpsd/ Pushpal Sidhu <psidhu.devel@gmail.com>

Depending on your architecture, it only requires about 40 bytes of data per message stream (in a web server that is per connection). https://github.com/nodejs/http-parser Ramanathan Sivagurunathan <ramzthecoder@gmail.com>, Hirokazu MORIKAWA <morikw2@gmail.com>

ab4eb23830b3379990064cb3ee2a04b70ca88284.english: libiio is used to interface to the Linux Industrial Input/Output (IIO) Subsystem. The Linux IIO subsystem is intended to provide support for devices that in some sense are analog to digital or digital to analog converters (ADCs, DACs). This includes, but is not limited to ADCs, Accelerometers, Gyros, IMUs, Capacitance to Digital Converters (CDCs), Pressure Sensors, Color, Light and Proximity Sensors, Temperature Sensors, Magnetometers, DACs, DDS (Direct Digital Synthesis), PLLs (Phase Locked Loops), Variable/Programmable Gain Amplifiers (VGA, PGA), and RF transceivers. You can use libiio natively on an embedded Linux target (local mode), or use libiio to communicate remotely to that same target from a host Linux, Windows or MAC over USB or Ethernet or Serial. https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/libiio Michael Heimpold <mhei@heimpold.de>

translations.zh-CN: libio用于与Linux工业输入/输出(IIO)子系统的接口. Linux IIO子系统旨在为在某种意义上模拟到数字或数字到模拟转换器(ADCs,DACs)的设备提供支持. 这包括但不仅限于ADC、加速计、Gyros、IMU、对数字转换器(CDC)、压力传感器、彩色、光和近相传感器、温度传感器、磁强计、DAC、DDS(直接数字合成)、PLL(相锁循环)、可变增益放大器(VGA、PGA)和RF收发器。 您可以在嵌入式 Linux 目标( 本地模式) 上本土使用 libio, 或者使用 libio 从主机 Linux, Windows 或 MAC 远程通信到同一目标 USB 或 以太网 或 串行 。 (原始内容存档于2017-10-07) (英语). https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/libiio 迈克尔·海姆波德 <mihei@heimpold.de>

4526f05b90ca6c44e6dcdc953dac3d826a50bb61.english: libmnl is a minimalistic user-space library oriented to Netlink developers. There are a lot of common tasks in parsing, validating, constructing of both the Netlink header and TLVs that are repetitive and easy to get wrong. This library aims to provide simple helpers that allows you to re-use code and to avoid re-inventing the wheel. The main features of this library are: . * Small: the shared library requires around 30KB for an x86-based computer. . * Simple: this library avoids complexity and elaborated abstractions that tend to hide Netlink details. . * Easy to use: the library simplifies the work for Netlink-wise developers. It provides functions to make socket handling, message building, validating, parsing and sequence tracking, easier. . * Easy to re-use: you can use the library to build your own abstraction layer on top of this library. . * Decoupling: the interdependency of the main bricks that compose the library is reduced, i.e. the library provides many helpers, but the programmer is not forced to use them. http://www.netfilter.org/projects/libmnl/ Jo-Philipp Wich <jo@mein.io>

translations.zh-CN: Libmnl是一个面向Netlink开发者的最小化用户-空间库. 在解析,验证,构建"Netlink"头和"TLV"上有很多常见的任务都是重复的,容易出错. 这个库旨在提供简单的帮助,使您能够重新使用代码并避免重出炉轮. 这个图书馆的主要功能是:. * 小:共享的图书馆需要30KB左右的基于x86的计算机. . *简单:这个库避免了复杂而细化的抽象,往往隐藏了Netlink的细节. . * 易用:库为Netlink-wise开发者简化了工作. 它提供功能,使套接字处理,消息构建,验证,解析和序列跟踪更加容易. . * 易再用: 您可以使用库来在本库上方自建抽象层. . *脱钩:构成图书馆的主要砖块的相互依存性被降低,即图书馆提供许多帮助,但程序员并不被迫使用. http://www.netfilter.org/projects/libmnl/ 乔-菲利普·维克 <jo@mein.io>

70ef03315a6de97f48aae1cdf927d427cc89a769.english: neon is an HTTP and WebDAV client library, with a C interface. Features: - High-level wrappers for common HTTP and WebDAV operations (GET, MOVE, DELETE, etc) - Low-level interface to the HTTP request/response engine, allowing the use of arbitrary HTTP methods, headers, etc. - Authentication support including Basic and Digest support, along with GSSAPI-based Negotiate on Unix, and SSPI-based Negotiate/NTLM on Win32 - SSL/TLS support using OpenSSL or GnuTLS; exposing an abstraction layer for verifying server certificates, handling client certificates, and examining certificate properties. Smartcard-based client certificates are also supported via a PKCS11 wrapper interface. - Abstract interface to parsing XML using libxml2 or expat, and wrappers for simplifying handling XML HTTP response bodies - WebDAV metadata support; wrappers for PROPFIND and PROPPATCH to simplify property manipulation. https://notroj.github.io/neon/ Federico Di Marco <fededim@gmail.com>

translations.zh-CN: 霓虹是一款HTTP和WebDAV客户端库,有C接口. 特性: - 为常见的HTTP和WebDAV操作(GET,MOVE,DELETE等)提供高水平的包头-为HTTP请求/响应引擎提供低水平的接口,允许使用任意的HTTP方法,头等 - 认证支持,包括Basic和Digest支持,连同GSSAPI基于Unix的谈判,以及SSPI基于Win32上的SSL/NTLM支持 - 使用OpenSSL或GnuTLS的SSL/TLS支持;曝光一个抽象层来验证服务器证书,处理客户证书,并检查证书属性. 基于Smartcard的客户端证书也通过PKCS11包装器接口支持. - 使用 libxml2 或 expat 解析 XML 的抽象界面,以及用于简化处理 XML HTTP 响应机构的包装- WebDAV 元数据支持; PROPFIND 和 PROPPATCH 的包装以简化属性操纵. https://notroj.github.io/neon/ 费德里科·迪·马可 <fedim@gmail.com>

4693b7b91d8ffa2b25299e1875be705c181f3ee6.english:
Enable JIT (Just-In-Time) compiler support.

Just-in-time compiling is a heavyweight optimization that can greatly
speed up pattern matching. However, it comes at the cost of extra
processing before the match is performed, so it is of most benefit when
the same pattern is going to be matched many times. This does not
necessarily mean many calls of a matching function; if the pattern is
not anchored, matching attempts may take place many times at various
positions in the subject, even for a single call. Therefore, if the
subject string is very long, it may still pay to use JIT even for
one-off matches. JIT support is available for all of the 8-bit, 16-bit
and 32-bit PCRE2 libraries and adds about 100KB to the resulting
libpcre2.so. JIT support applies only to the traditional Perl-compatible
matching function. It does not apply when the DFA matching function is
being used.

Enabling this option can give an about 10x performance increase on JIT
operations. It can be desireable for e.g. high performance Apache
mod_rewrite or HA-Proxy reqrep operations.

However, JIT should _only_ be enabled on architectures that are supported.
Enabling JIT on unsupported platforms will result in a compilation
failure. A list of supported architectures can be found here:
https://pcre.org/current/doc/html/pcre2jit.html#SEC2

2d2d49218cfa775ae1b7467e000a35198a0c6ee4.english: RRD is the Acronym for Round Robin Database. RRD is a system to store and display time-series data (i.e. network bandwidth, machine-room temperature, server load average). It stores the data in a very compact way that will not expand over time, and it presents useful graphs by processing the data to enforce a certain data density. It can be used either via simple wrapper scripts (from shell or Perl) or via frontends that poll network devices and put friendly user interface on it. This is version 1.0.x with cgilib-0.4, gd1.3 and libpng-1.0.9 linked into librrd.so. The library is much smaller compared to the 1.2.x version with separate dynamic linked libraries. This package contains a shared library, used by other programs. http://oss.oetiker.ch/rrdtool/ Jo-Philipp Wich <jo@mein.io>

translations.zh-CN: RRD是圆罗宾数据库的缩写. RRD是一个存储并显示时间序列数据(即网络带宽,机房温度,服务器负载平均值)的系统. 它以非常紧凑的方式存储数据,不会随时间而扩展,它通过处理数据来强制一定的数据密度来提供有用的图表. 它可以通过简单的包装脚本(从 shell 或 Perl)或者通过前端来进行网络设备的投票并在上面放上友好的用户界面来使用. 这是1.0.x版本,带有cgilib-0.4,gd1.3和libpng-1.0.9链接到librd.so. 与1.2.x版本相比,图书馆规模要小得多,有单独的动态链接库. 此软件包包含一个共享库,被其他程序所使用. http://oss.oetiker.ch/rrdtool/ 乔-菲利普·维克 <jo@mein.io>

7869febe671fa2b3b9955a7054b6ffee8fa2716f.english: libselinux is the runtime SELinux library that provides interfaces (e.g. library functions for the SELinux kernel APIs like getcon(), other support functions like getseuserbyname()) to SELinux-aware applications. libselinux may use the shared libsepol to manipulate the binary policy if necessary (e.g. to downgrade the policy format to an older version supported by the kernel) when loading policy. http://selinuxproject.org/page/Main_Page Thomas Petazzoni <thomas.petazzoni@bootlin.com>

a94c9996516d10b6ee5d3008a8c16203c7235ab8.english: NaCl (pronounced "salt") is a new easy-to-use high-speed software library for network communication, encryption, decryption, signatures, etc. NaCl's goal is to provide all of the core operations needed to build higher-level cryptographic tools. Sodium is a portable, cross-compilable, installable, packageable fork of NaCl (based on the latest released upstream version nacl-20110221), with a compatible API. The design choices, particularly in regard to the Curve25519 Diffie-Hellman function, emphasize security (whereas NIST curves emphasize "performance" at the cost of security), and "magic constants" in NaCl/Sodium have clear rationales. The same cannot be said of NIST curves, where the specific origins of certain constants are not described by the standards. And despite the emphasis on higher security, primitives are faster across-the-board than most implementations of the NIST standards. https://github.com/jedisct1/libsodium Damiano Renfer <x9w2n7xnu@relay.firefox.com>

translations.zh-CN: NaCl(发音为"盐")是一款新型易用高速软件库,用于网络通信,加密,解密,签名等. NaCl的目标是提供建造更高级密码工具所需的所有核心操作. Sodium是一种可移植,可交叉编译,可安装,可包装的NaCl分叉(基于最新发布的上游版nacl-20110221),有相容的API. 设计选择,特别是在Curve25519 Diffie-Hellman函数方面,强调安全性(因为NIST曲线以安全为代价强调"性能"),而"魔法常数"在NaCl/Sodium中有明确的理由. NIST曲线不能这么说,因为标准没有描述某些常数的具体起源。 而尽管强调更高的安全性,原始人的全面执行速度比大多数NIST标准的执行速度快. https://github.com/jedisct1/libsodium Damiano Renfer <x9w2n7xnu@relay.firefox.com> (英语).

1da5d732a75f9be67c92b1e22fdaa0f30494244e.english: libv4l is a collection of libraries which adds a thin abstraction layer on top of video4linux2 devices. The purpose of this (thin) layer is to make it easy for application writers to support a wide variety of devices without having to write separate code for different devices in the same class. libv4l consists of 3 different libraries: libv4lconvert, libv4l1 and libv4l2. libv4l1 offers the (deprecated) v4l1 API on top of v4l2 devices, independent of the drivers for those devices supporting v4l1 compatibility (which many v4l2 drivers do not). libv4l2 offers the v4l2 API on top of v4l2 devices, while adding for the application transparent libv4lconvert conversion where necessary. https://www.linuxtv.org/ Ted Hess <thess@kitschensync.net>

translations.zh-CN: libv4l是图书馆的集合,在视频4linux2设备上方增加了一薄抽象层. 这个(thin)层的用意是方便应用程序作者支持多种设备,而无需为同类的不同设备单独写出代码. libv4l由3个不同的库组成: libv4lconvert, libv4l1和libv4l2. libv4l1在v4l2设备上提供(已失效)v4l1 API,独立于那些支持v4l1兼容性的设备的驱动程序(许多v4l2驱动程序并不提供). libv4l2在v4l2设备上方提供v4l2 API,同时在必要时为应用程序添加透明libv4lconvert转换. (原始内容存档于2018-09-29) (英语). https://www.linuxtv.org/ Ted Hess <thes@kitschensync.net>

16ce77aa70a6444334a736d49f68d62afa37d2b5.english: Vorbis is a general purpose audio and music encoding format contemporary to MPEG-4's AAC and TwinVQ, the next generation beyond MPEG audio layer 3. 23277764e393ec4aaa790688eb0a003dab275188.english: Emailrelay is a simple SMTP proxy and store-and-forward message transfer agent (MTA). When running as a proxy all e-mail messages can be passed through a user-defined program, such as a spam filter, which can drop, re-address or edit messages as they pass through. When running as a store-and-forward MTA incoming messages are stored in a local spool directory, and then forwarded to the next SMTP server on request. http://emailrelay.sourceforge.net/ Federico Di Marco <fededim@gmail.com>

translations.zh-CN: Emailrelay是一个简单的SMTP代理和存储和转发消息传输代理(MTA). 在作为代理运行时,所有电子邮件消息都可以通过用户定义的程序传递,如垃圾邮件过滤器,在消息通过时可以发送,重新处理或编辑. 当作为存储和转发的 MTA 消息运行时,会存储在本地的集合目录中,然后根据请求转发到下一个 SMTP 服务器. http://emailrelay.sourceforge.net/ 费德里科·迪·马可 <fedim@gmail.com>

c68ce1cb5a52a8d8878bc6073f705b7f68f315e3.english: fswebcam is a neat and simple webcam app. It captures images from a V4L1/V4L2 compatible device or file, averages them to reduce noise and draws a caption using the GD Graphics Library which also handles compressing the image to PNG or JPEG. The resulting image is saved to a file or sent to stdio where it can be piped to something like ncftpput or scp. http://www.sanslogic.co.uk/fswebcam/ Nicolas Thill <nico@openwrt.org>

translations.zh-CN: fswebcam是一个整洁而简单的webcam应用. 它从一个V4L1/V4L2兼容的设备或文件中捕捉图像,平均它们以减少噪音,并使用GD图形库绘制一个标题,该库也处理将图像压缩到PNG或JPEG. 由此产生的图像被保存到一个文件或发送到stdio,在那里它可以被管道到像 ncftpput 或 scp 之类的东西. (原始内容存档于2018-09-29) (英语). http://www.sanslogic.co.uk/fswebcam/ Nicolas Thill (nico@openwrt.org).

d588dafcaa7e06efc76474c301a2cf96418fa249.english: Mesh11sd is a dynamic parameter configuration daemon for 802.11s mesh networks. It was originally designed to leverage 802.11s mesh networking at Captive Portal venues. This is the open source version and it enables easy and automated mesh network operation with multiple mesh nodes. It allows all mesh parameters supported by the wireless driver to be set in the uci config file. Settings take effect immediately without having to restart the wireless network. Default settings give rapid and reliable layer 2 mesh convergence. Without mesh11sd, many mesh parameters cannot be set in the uci wireless config file as the mesh interface must be up before the parameters can be set. Some of those that are supported, would fail to be implemented when the network is (re)started resulting in errors or dropped nodes. The mesh11sd daemon dynamically checks configured parameters and sets them as required. This version does not require a Captive Portal to be running. https://github.com/opennds/mesh11sd Rob White <rob@blue-wave.net>

translations.zh-CN: Mesh11sd是802.11s mesh网络的动态参数配置守护进程. 它最初的设计是为了在Captive Portal地点利用802.11s的网格网络. 这是开源版本,它能使网状网络操作容易和自动化,并有多个网状节点. 它允许无线驱动程序支持的所有网格参数被设置在uci配置文件中. 设置立即生效,无需重新启动无线网络。 默认设置可以快速可靠地实现第2层网格汇合. 没有 mesh11sd ,许多 mesh 参数无法在 uci 无线配置文件中设置,因为 mesh 接口必须上架才能设置参数. 有些得到支持,当网络(重新)启动导致错误或节点掉落时将无法执行. mesh11sd 守护进程动态检查配置参数并按需要设置. 这个版本不需要Captive门户网站运行. https://github.com/opennds/mesh11sd 罗布·怀特 <rob@blue-wave.net>

71f676655771f1c87ed978483995e2abf8072a83.english: openNDS is a Captive Portal solution that offers an instant way to provide restricted access to the Internet. With little or no configuration, a dynamically generated and adaptive splash page sequence is automatically served. Both client driven Captive Portal Detection (CPD) and gateway driven Captive Portal Identification (CPI - RFC 8910 and RFC 8908) are supported. Internet access is granted by either a click to continue button, or after credential verification as a result of filling in a login form. The package incorporates the FAS API allowing many flexible customisation options. The creation of sophisticated third party authentication applications is fully supported. Internet hosted https portals can be implemented with no security errors, to inspire maximum user confidence. This version requires iptables-legacy. https://github.com/opennds/opennds Rob White <rob@blue-wave.net>

translations.zh-CN: openNDS是一个Captive Portal解决方案,它提供了提供限制访问互联网的即时途径. 很少或没有配置,自动提供动态生成和适应性溅射的页面序列。 支持客户端驱动的Captive门户网站检测(CPD)和网关驱动的Captive门户网站识别(CPI - RFC 8910和RFC 8908). 互联网接入要么通过点击继续按键,要么由于填写登录表而经过证书验证。 该套装包含了FAS API,允许许多灵活的自定义选项. 建立精密的第三方认证应用程序得到充分的支持. 互联网托管的https门户网站可以在没有安全错误的情况下实施,以激发最大用户信心. 这个版本需要iptales-legacy. https://github.com/opennds/opennds 罗布·怀特 <rob@blue-wave.net>

39152da11300a23bec85e42a6396ffef1a082a08.english: LFTP is a sophisticated file transfer program with command line interface. It supports FTP, HTTP, FISH, SFTP, HTTPS and FTPS protocols. GNU Readline library is used for input. Every operation in lftp is reliable, that is any non-fatal error is handled and the operation is retried automatically. So if downloading breaks, it will be restarted from the point automatically. Even if ftp server does not support REST command, lftp will try to retrieve the file from the very beginning until the file is transferred completely. This is useful for dynamic-ip machines which change their IP addresses quite often, and for sites with very bad internet connectivity. lftp has shell-like command syntax allowing you to launch several commands in parallel in background (&). It is also possible to group commands within () and execute them in background. All background jobs are executed in the same single process. You can bring a foreground job to background with ^Z (c-z) and back with command `wait' (or `fg' which is alias to `wait'). To list running jobs, use command `jobs'. Some commands allow redirecting their output (cat, ls, ...) to file or via pipe to external command. Commands can be executed conditionally based on termination status of previous command (&&, ||). lftp has builtin mirror which can download or update a whole directory tree. There is also reverse mirror (mirror -R) which uploads or updates a directory tree on server. https://lftp.yar.ru/ Federico Di Marco <fededim@gmail.com>

d64ae03246d4da97e13ac0df14d6c1a3ac8e3297.english: Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV), an extension to the HTTP-protocol, allows authoring of resources on a remote web server.davfs2 provides the ability to access such resources like a typical filesystem, allowing for use by standard applications with no built-in support for WebDAV. davfs2 is designed to fully integrate into the filesystem semantics of Unix-like systems (mount, umount, etc.). davfs2 makes mounting by unprivileged users as easy and secure as possible. davfs2 does extensive caching to make the file system responsive, to avoid unnecessary network traffic and to prevent data loss, and to cope for slow or unreliable connections. davfs2 will work with most WebDAV servers needing little or no configuration. https://savannah.nongnu.org/projects/davfs2/ Federico Di Marco <fededim@gmail.com>

b02acb23f4aaf11e1791feec47ea2fd171c3236b.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS ftp server. https://github.com/owfs/owfs Jo-Philipp Wich <jo@mein.io>

0d990482f02455ca4029f3e36f0963a5d32cfa92.english: iptables extensions for matching cluster. Netfilter (IPv4/IPv6) module for matching cluster This option allows you to build work-load-sharing clusters of network servers/stateful firewalls without having a dedicated load-balancing router/server/switch. Basically, this match returns true when the packet must be handled by this cluster node. Thus, all nodes see all packets and this match decides which node handles what packets. The work-load sharing algorithm is based on source address hashing. This module is usable for ipv4 and ipv6. If you select it, it enables kmod-ipt-cluster. see `iptables -m cluster --help` for more information. https://netfilter.org/

3ee4a522496f6f9cb956d259de175efe123f8441.english: Avahi is an mDNS/DNS-SD (aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf) implementation (library). It facilitates service discovery on a local network -- this means that you can plug your laptop or computer into a network and instantly be able to view other people who you can chat with, find printers to print to or find files being shared. This kind of technology is already found in MacOS X (branded 'Rendezvous', 'Bonjour' and sometimes 'ZeroConf') and is very convenient. . This package implements IPv4LL, "Dynamic Configuration of IPv4 Link-Local Addresses" (IETF RFC3927), a protocol for automatic IP address configuration from the link-local 169.254.0.0/16 range without the need for a central server. It is primarily intended to be used in ad-hoc networks which lack a DHCP server. http://www.avahi.org/ Ted Hess <thess@kitschensync.net>

translations.zh-CN: Avahi是一个mDNS/DNS-SD(aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf)执行(图书馆). 它为本地网络上的服务发现提供了便利——这意味着你可以将你的笔记本电脑或计算机插入网络,并立即能够查看其他人,你可以和他们聊天,找到打印机打印到或找到正在共享的文件. 此类技术已经在MacOS X(品牌为"Rendezvous","Bonjour",有时为"ZeroConf")中找到,并且非常方便. . 此套件执行 IPv4LL,"IPv4 Link-local addresses的动态配置"(IETF RFC3927),一个从链接-local 169.254.0.0/16范围自动配置IP的协议,不需要中央服务器. 它主要用于缺乏DHCP服务器的特设网络。 http://www.avahi.org/ 泰德·赫斯 <thess@kitschensync.net> (中文(简体) ).
